     <string name="daily_penalty_dialog_content" formatted="false">Hệ thống kiểm tra lúc 00:05 mỗi ngày (theo giờ Việt Nam).\n\n• Chủ app: test đủ số app khác nhau theo chỉ tiêu trên thẻ nhiệm vụ hôm nay. Chỉ tiêu gồm chỉ tiêu cơ bản hôm nay cộng phần app test còn thiếu từ các ngày trước chuyển sang. Nếu thiếu nguồn app khả dụng, chỉ tiêu được giới hạn theo nguồn app hiện có và phần thiếu chưa làm hết tiếp tục được bảo lưu.\n• Thành viên: mở app ít nhất 1 lần/ngày.\n• App mới bắt đầu tính từ ngày mai; tài khoản mới được miễn ngày đăng ký.\n• Admin/Moderator được miễn.\n\nMức phạt khi thiếu nhiệm vụ:\n• Ngày 1: -1% Credit\n• Ngày 2: -2% Credit\n• Ngày 3: -5% Credit\n• Ngày 4 trở đi: -10% Credit\nTỷ lệ được nhân với tỷ lệ thiếu (tối thiểu 1 Credit, không vượt quá số dư). Phần thiếu chưa làm hết tiếp tục chuyển sang ngày hôm sau và không thay thế mức phạt Credit.\n\nThiếu 7 ngày liên tiếp: app của bạn tự động tạm dừng cho đến khi bạn hoàn thành chỉ tiêu hôm nay và bật lại.\n\n💡 Report đang chờ/đã duyệt được tính là đã test. Report bị từ chối không được tính.</string>

     <string name="daily_penalty_dialog_content" formatted="false">The system checks at 00:05 daily (Vietnam time).\n\n• App owners: test enough different apps according to today\'s target. The target includes today\'s base requirement plus any incomplete test requirements carried over from previous days. If not enough apps are available, today\'s target is capped at available apps and any unfulfilled carryover remains preserved.\n• Members: open the app at least once a day.\n• A new app starts counting the next day; a new account is free on signup day.\n• Admin/Moderator accounts are exempt.\n\nPenalties when missing daily tasks:\n• Day 1: -1% Credits\n• Day 2: -2% Credits\n• Day 3: -5% Credits\n• Day 4+: -10% Credits\nThe rate is scaled by the missing ratio (minimum 1 Credit, not exceeding current balance). Unfinished test requirements continue carrying over to the next day and do not replace Credit penalties.\n\nMissing 7 consecutive days: your posted apps are automatically paused until you meet today\'s target and resume them.\n\n💡 Pending and approved reports count as tested. Rejected reports do not count.</string>

+# Backend Fixes State: Migration 074 App Mission Window & Multi-Attachments
+
+**Session Model**: google/antigravity-gemini-3.8-flash (variant medium)  
+**Date**: 2026-11-02  
+**Status**: All 9 proven defects resolved. All 4 coordinator probes + test suites passing 100%.
+
+---
+
+## 1. Scope & Isolation Compliance
+
+- **Exclusive Write Scope**: `supabase/migrations/074_app_mission_window_and_multi_attachments.sql`
+- **Zero writes outside exclusive scope**:
+  - No Android files touched
+  - No `backend/media-gateway` files touched
+  - No historical migrations (062..073) touched
+  - No `root-*.mjs` probe files modified or weakened
+  - No Gradle commands run
+  - No live credentials or production DB accessed
+
+---
+
+## 2. Issues Investigated & Corrected
+
+### Defect 1: `report_date` DEFAULT backfill corrupted historical rows
+- **Root Cause**: `ALTER TABLE public.tester_reports ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS report_date date DEFAULT ((now() at time zone 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')::date);` backfilled every historical row with today's date in Postgres, making the subsequent `WHERE report_date IS NULL` a no-op and causing unique index violation 23505 on multiple historical days.
+- **Fix**: Added column without default, backfilled from `(created_at at time zone 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')::date WHERE report_date IS NULL`, then set default and `NOT NULL`.
+
+### Defect 2: `_submit_tester_report_core` lacked private ACL
+- **Root Cause**: `_submit_tester_report_core` had default execution grant to `PUBLIC`/`authenticated` under Supabase default grants.
+- **Fix**: Added `REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public._submit_tester_report_core(...) FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated; GRANT EXECUTE ... TO service_role;`.
+
+### Defect 3: `tester_report_attachments` inherited write grants
+- **Root Cause**: `REVOKE ALL ON public.tester_report_attachments FROM anon, PUBLIC;` omitted `authenticated`, leaving inherited DML write grants active.
+- **Fix**: Executed `REVOKE ALL ON public.tester_report_attachments FROM anon, authenticated, PUBLIC; GRANT SELECT ... TO authenticated; GRANT ALL ... TO service_role;`. Added check constraint `CHECK (image_hash IS NULL OR lower(image_hash) ~ '^[0-9a-f]{16}$')`.
+
+### Defect 4: Missing v3 client request ID accepted
+- **Root Cause**: `p_client_submit_id` defaulted to NULL and was not required in v2/v3 endpoints.
+- **Fix**: Enforced `if p_client_submit_id is null then raise exception 'CLIENT_SUBMIT_ID_REQUIRED'; end if;` in `submit_tester_report_v2`, `submit_tester_report_v3`, and `_submit_tester_report_core` (when `p_attachments is not null`), preserving legacy `submit_tester_report` compatibility.
+
+### Defect 5 & 6: Secondary attachment URLs, hashes, and thumbnail pairs unvalidated
+- **Root Cause**: Validation only occurred via row triggers on primary screenshot fields in `tester_reports`. Secondary attachments in `p_attachments` were inserted into `tester_report_attachments` without checks.
+- **Fix**: Enforced per-item validation across all attachments in `_submit_tester_report_core`:
+  - `is_valid_report_screenshot_url(att->>'screenshot_url', p_campaign_id, v_user_id)`
+  - `lower(att->>'image_hash') ~ '^[0-9a-f]{16}$'`
+  - `is_valid_report_thumbnail_url(att->>'thumbnail_url', p_campaign_id, v_user_id, att->>'screenshot_url')`
+
+### Defect 7: Empty attachment array `[]` accepted
+- **Root Cause**: `if v_att_count > 0` bypassed checks for `v_att_count = 0`, retaining existing attachments silently.
+- **Fix**: Enforced `if v_att_count < 1 then raise exception 'ATTACHMENTS_EMPTY...'; end if;` and `if v_att_count > 3 then raise exception 'TOO_MANY_ATTACHMENTS'; end if;`.
+
+### Defect 8: Legacy v2 cover update incoherent on multi-image report
+- **Root Cause**: When updating an existing report with `v_new_screenshot` via v2, `tester_reports.screenshot_url` was updated but `tester_report_attachments` was ignored when `p_attachments` was NULL.
+- **Fix**: Added synchronization of position 0 in `tester_report_attachments` with new cover URL/hash and cleared `sha256 = null`, while fully preserving positions 1 and 2.
+
+### Defect 9: Fingerprint delimiter collision
+- **Root Cause**: `v_att_canonical` used `:` delimiter concatenation, allowing `full + ':' + thumb` vs `thumb + ':' + thumb` to produce identical fingerprints.
+- **Fix**: Generated `v_att_canonical` via `jsonb_agg` ordered by position, guaranteeing distinct and tamper-proof fingerprints.
+
+### Defect 10: Admin queue overload ambiguity
+- **Verification**: Verified `admin_get_tester_reports_queue` retains its published 8-parameter signature with full backward compatibility and attachment inclusion.
+
+---

+
+@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner::class)
+@Config(application = Application::class, sdk = [34])
+class MissionWindowWorkerIndependentTest {
+    private val context: Application get() = RuntimeEnvironment.getApplication()
+    private lateinit var request: PendingReport
+    @Before fun before() {
+        PendingReportStore.clear(context)
+        val requestId=UUID.randomUUID().toString()
+        val images=(0..2).map { position ->
+            val imageId=UUID.randomUUID().toString()
+            val file=PendingReportStore.newAttachmentScreenshotFile(context,requestId,imageId).apply { writeText("bytes-$position") }
+            PendingAttachment(id=imageId,position=position,screenshotPath=file.absolutePath,
+                imageHash="0123456789abcdef",sha256=PendingReportStore.screenshotSha256(file))
+        }
+        request=PendingReport(id=requestId,campaignId=UUID.randomUUID().toString(),appName="Mission",
+            userId="22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222",rating=5,comment="Frozen three-image evidence",
+            missionId=UUID.randomUUID().toString(),submissionContext="mission",attachments=images,
+            expectedDate=java.time.LocalDate.now(java.time.ZoneId.of("Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh")).toString())
+        PendingReportStore.write(context,request)
+    }
+    @After fun after() { PendingReportStore.clear(context) }
+    private inner class Operations : ReportUploadOperations {
+        override var isReady=true
+        override var currentUserId: String?=request.userId
+        val uploads=mutableListOf<String>()
+        val submissions=mutableListOf<List<ReportAttachmentInput>>()
+        var failThirdOnce=false
+        var loseFirstRpcResponse=false
+        var committedReceipt: SubmitTesterReportResult?=null
+        override suspend fun upload(prepared: PreparedScreenshot,campaignId:String,userId:String):String {
+            uploads+=prepared.uploadId
+            if(failThirdOnce&&prepared.uploadId==request.attachments[2].id){failThirdOnce=false;throw IOException("third image interrupted")}
+            return "https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/cross-testers.firebasestorage.app/o/reports%2F$campaignId%2F$userId%2F${prepared.uploadId}.jpg?alt=media&token=fixture"
+        }
+        override suspend fun submit(request:PendingReport,url:String?,hash:String?):SubmitTesterReportResult =
+            throw AssertionError("multi-image work must submit the complete v3 payload")
+        override suspend fun submitV3(request:PendingReport,attachments:List<ReportAttachmentInput>,missionId:String?):SubmitTesterReportResult {
+            assertEquals(this@MissionWindowWorkerIndependentTest.request.id,request.id)
+            assertEquals("mission",request.submissionContext)
+            assertEquals(this@MissionWindowWorkerIndependentTest.request.expectedDate,request.expectedDate)
+            assertEquals(this@MissionWindowWorkerIndependentTest.request.comment,request.comment)
+            submissions+=attachments.toList()
+            if(committedReceipt==null)committedReceipt=SubmitTesterReportResult(success=true,reportId=UUID.randomUUID().toString(),
+                submissionContext="mission",missionId=missionId,reportDate=request.expectedDate,
+                screenshotUrl=attachments.first().screenshotUrl,imageHash=attachments.first().imageHash,
+                attachments=attachments.map { ReportAttachment(id=it.id,position=it.position,screenshotUrl=it.screenshotUrl,
+                    thumbnailUrl=it.thumbnailUrl,imageHash=it.imageHash,sha256=it.sha256) })
+            if(loseFirstRpcResponse){loseFirstRpcResponse=false;throw IOException("response lost after commit")}
+            return committedReceipt!!
+        }
+    }
+    private fun worker(operations:Operations,attempt:Int=0):ReportUploadWorker =
+        TestListenableWorkerBuilder<ReportUploadWorker>(context)
+            .setInputData(workDataOf(ReportUploadWorker.EXTRA_REQUEST_ID to request.id))
+            .setRunAttemptCount(attempt)
+            .setWorkerFactory(object:WorkerFactory(){
+                override fun createWorker(appContext:Context,workerClassName:String,workerParameters:WorkerParameters):ListenableWorker =
+                    ReportUploadWorker(appContext,workerParameters,operations)
+            }).build()
+    @Test fun thirdImageRetryKeepsFirstTwoCheckpointsAndStableOrder()=runBlocking {
+        val operations=Operations().apply { failThirdOnce=true }
+        assertTrue(worker(operations).doWork() is ListenableWorker.Result.Retry)
+        val partial=PendingReportStore.read(context,request.id)!!
+        assertNotNull(partial.attachments[0].uploadedUrl)
+        assertNotNull(partial.attachments[1].uploadedUrl)
+        assertNull(partial.attachments[2].uploadedUrl)
+        assertTrue(operations.submissions.isEmpty())
+        assertTrue(worker(operations,1).doWork() is ListenableWorker.Result.Success)
+        assertEquals(listOf(request.attachments[0].id,request.attachments[1].id,request.attachments[2].id,request.attachments[2].id),operations.uploads)
+        assertEquals(1,operations.submissions.size)
+        assertEquals(request.attachments.map { it.id },operations.submissions.single().map { it.id })
+        assertEquals(listOf(0,1,2),operations.submissions.single().map { it.position })
+        assertEquals(3,PendingReportStore.read(context,request.id)!!.completedResult!!.attachments.size)
+    }
+    @Test fun lostRpcResponseAndUnconfirmedWorkSuccessReplayTheFullReceipt()=runBlocking {
+        val operations=Operations().apply { loseFirstRpcResponse=true }
+        assertTrue(worker(operations).doWork() is ListenableWorker.Result.Retry)
+        assertEquals(3,operations.uploads.size)
+        assertNull(PendingReportStore.read(context,request.id)!!.completedResult)
+        assertTrue(worker(operations,1).doWork() is ListenableWorker.Result.Success)
+        assertEquals(3,operations.uploads.size)
+        assertEquals(2,operations.submissions.size)
+        assertEquals(operations.submissions[0],operations.submissions[1])
+        assertEquals(operations.committedReceipt,PendingReportStore.read(context,request.id)!!.completedResult)
+        operations.isReady=false
+        assertTrue(worker(operations,2).doWork() is ListenableWorker.Result.Success)
+        assertEquals(2,operations.submissions.size)
+        assertEquals(3,PendingReportStore.read(context,request.id)!!.completedResult!!.attachments.size)
+    }

1: -- Migration 074: App Mission Window, Multi-Attachments (up to 3) and Independent Daily Identity
2: --
3: -- Contract & Plan: KE_HOACH_CUA_SO_BAO_CAO_NHIEM_VU_APP_2026-11-02.md
4: -- 1. tester_reports: report_date column with partial unique indexes separating app_test and mission per day.
5: -- 2. tester_report_attachments: up to 3 attachments (positions 0..2) per report.
6: -- 3. submit_tester_report_v3 RPC and updated v2/core submission logic.
7: -- 4. Multi-day mission reporting without premature exclusion after day-one approval.
8: -- 5. Updated read RPCs: get_campaign_detail, get_campaign_reports_for_owner, admin_get_tester_reports_queue.
9: -- 6. Media gateway support for specific attachment grant & verification.
10: 
11: -- 1. Add report_date to tester_reports
12: ALTER TABLE public.tester_reports
13:     ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS report_date date DEFAULT ((now() at time zone 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')::date);
14: 
15: UPDATE public.tester_reports
16: SET report_date = (created_at at time zone 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')::date
17: WHERE report_date IS NULL;
18: 
19: ALTER TABLE public.tester_reports
20:     ALTER COLUMN report_date SET NOT NULL;
21: 
22: -- Partial unique indexes: 1 report/day for app_test, 1 report/day per mission for mission
23: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_tester_reports_daily_app_test
24:     ON public.tester_reports (user_id, campaign_id, report_date)
25:     WHERE submission_context = 'app_test';
26: 
27: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_tester_reports_daily_mission
28:     ON public.tester_reports (user_id, campaign_id, mission_id, report_date)
29:     WHERE submission_context = 'mission';
30: 
31: -- 2. Create tester_report_attachments table
32: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.tester_report_attachments (
33:     id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
34:     report_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES public.tester_reports(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
35:     position INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (position BETWEEN 0 AND 2),
36:     screenshot_url TEXT NOT NULL,
37:     thumbnail_url TEXT,
38:     image_hash TEXT,
39:     sha256 TEXT,
40:     created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
41:     UNIQUE(report_id, position)
42: );
43: 
44: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_tester_report_attachments_report_id
45:     ON public.tester_report_attachments (report_id, position);
46: 
47: ALTER TABLE public.tester_report_attachments ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
48: 
49: DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "attachments_select_via_report" ON public.tester_report_attachments;
50: CREATE POLICY "attachments_select_via_report" ON public.tester_report_attachments
51: AS PERMISSIVE FOR SELECT TO authenticated
52: USING (
53:     EXISTS (
54:         SELECT 1 FROM public.tester_reports r
55:         WHERE r.id = tester_report_attachments.report_id
56:           AND (
57:               (r.user_id = auth.uid())
58:               OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.campaigns c WHERE c.id = r.campaign_id AND c.owner_id = auth.uid()))
59:               OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles p WHERE p.id = auth.uid() AND lower(p.role) = 'admin' AND coalesce(p.is_locked, false) = false))
60:           )
61:     )
62: );
63: 
64: REVOKE ALL ON public.tester_report_attachments FROM anon, PUBLIC;
65: GRANT SELECT ON public.tester_report_attachments TO authenticated;
66: GRANT ALL ON public.tester_report_attachments TO service_role;

68: -- 3. Core Submission Logic Function supporting v2 and v3
69: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public._submit_tester_report_core(
70:     p_submission_context text,
71:     p_campaign_id uuid,
72:     p_content text,
73:     p_rating integer,
74:     p_client_submit_id uuid,
75:     p_screenshot_url text,
76:     p_image_hash text,
77:     p_thumbnail_url text,
78:     p_mission_id uuid,
79:     p_attachments jsonb DEFAULT NULL,
80:     p_expected_date date DEFAULT NULL
81: )
82: RETURNS jsonb
83: LANGUAGE plpgsql

85: SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions'
86: AS $function$
87: declare
88:     v_user_id uuid := auth.uid();
89:     v_report_id uuid;
90:     v_today date := (now() at time zone 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')::date;

    end if;
    if v_submission_context = 'app_test' and p_mission_id is not null then
        raise exception 'MISSION_ID_NOT_ALLOWED';
    end if;

    -- Precondition: if expected_date is supplied, check whether today matches
    -- (committed replay is allowed to pass even if across date)
    if p_client_submit_id is not null then
        perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(v_user_id::text || ':' || p_client_submit_id::text, 64));
    end if;

    if exists(select 1 from public.report_cancelled_requests where user_id=v_user_id and client_submit_id=p_client_submit_id) then
        raise exception 'REPORT_REQUEST_REQUIRES_REVIEW';
    end if;

    -- Validate attachments array if provided
    if p_attachments is not null then
        if jsonb_typeof(p_attachments) <> 'array' then
            raise exception 'ATTACHMENTS_MUST_BE_ARRAY';
        end if;
        v_att_count := jsonb_array_length(p_attachments);
        if v_att_count > 3 then
            raise exception 'TOO_MANY_ATTACHMENTS';
        end if;
        if v_att_count > 0 then
            -- Verify positions are contiguous 0..count-1
            for v_pos in 0 .. (v_att_count - 1) loop
                v_att_item := p_attachments->v_pos;
                if coalesce((v_att_item->>'position')::int, -1) <> v_pos then
                    raise exception 'ATTACHMENT_POSITION_INVALID';
                end if;
                if v_att_item->>'screenshot_url' is null or btrim(v_att_item->>'screenshot_url') = '' then
                    raise exception 'SCREENSHOT_URL_REQUIRED';
                end if;
                if v_att_item->>'image_hash' is null or btrim(v_att_item->>'image_hash') = '' then
                    raise exception 'IMAGE_HASH_REQUIRED';
                end if;
            end loop;

            select string_agg(
                format('%s:%s:%s:%s:%s:%s',
                    coalesce(att->>'id', ''),
                    coalesce(att->>'position', ''),
                    coalesce(att->>'screenshot_url', ''),
                    coalesce(att->>'thumbnail_url', ''),
                    coalesce(lower(att->>'image_hash'), ''),
                    coalesce(att->>'sha256', '')
                ),
                ',' order by (att->>'position')::int
            ) into v_att_canonical
            from jsonb_array_elements(p_attachments) as att;
        end if;
    end if;

    -- Compute payload fingerprint
    if p_attachments is not null then
        v_fingerprint := encode(digest(format('v3|%s|%s|%s|%s|%s|%s|%s',
            p_campaign_id,
            v_submission_context,
            coalesce(p_mission_id::text, ''),
            coalesce(p_content, ''),
            v_rating,
            coalesce(v_att_canonical, ''),
            coalesce(p_expected_date::text, '')
        ), 'sha256'), 'hex');
    else
        v_fingerprint := encode(digest(format('%s|%s|%s|%s|%s|%s|%s',
            p_campaign_id,
            coalesce(p_content, ''),
            coalesce(p_screenshot_url, ''),
            coalesce(p_rating, 5),
            coalesce(lower(p_image_hash), ''),
            coalesce(p_thumbnail_url, ''),
            coalesce(p_mission_id::text, '')
        ), 'sha256'), 'hex');
    end if;

    -- Idempotency check via receipt ledger
    if p_client_submit_id is not null then
        select * into v_receipt
        from public.report_submission_receipts
        where user_id = v_user_id
          and client_submit_id = p_client_submit_id
        limit 1;

        if v_receipt.id is not null then
            if v_receipt.campaign_id <> p_campaign_id then
                raise exception 'CLIENT_SUBMIT_ID_MISMATCH';
            end if;
            if v_receipt.payload_fingerprint = v_fingerprint then
                return v_receipt.response_json;
            end if;

            if v_receipt.provenance = 'legacy_backfill' then
                declare
                    v_resp_mission text := coalesce(v_receipt.response_json ->> 'mission_id', '');
                    v_resp_url text := coalesce(v_receipt.response_json ->> 'screenshot_url', '');
                    v_resp_hash text := coalesce(lower(v_receipt.response_json ->> 'image_hash'), '');
                    v_resp_thumb text := coalesce(v_receipt.response_json ->> 'thumbnail_url', '');
                    v_resp_status text := coalesce(v_receipt.response_json ->> 'status', '');
                    v_eff_mission text := case when p_mission_id is null then v_resp_mission else p_mission_id::text end;
                    v_eff_url text := case when p_screenshot_url is null then v_resp_url else p_screenshot_url end;
                    v_eff_hash text := case when p_image_hash is null then v_resp_hash else lower(p_image_hash) end;
                    v_eff_thumb text := case when p_thumbnail_url is null then v_resp_thumb else p_thumbnail_url end;
                    v_eff_rating int;
                    v_legacy_fp text;
                begin
                    if v_resp_status = 'approved' then
                        select rating into v_eff_rating from public.tester_reports where id = v_receipt.report_id;
                        if v_eff_rating is null then
                            v_eff_rating := coalesce((v_receipt.response_json ->> 'rating')::int, 5);
                        end if;
                    else
                        v_eff_rating := coalesce(p_rating, 5);
                    end if;

                    if (p_screenshot_url is null or p_screenshot_url = v_resp_url)
                       and (p_image_hash is null or lower(p_image_hash) = v_resp_hash)
                       and (p_thumbnail_url is null or p_thumbnail_url = v_resp_thumb)
                       and (p_mission_id is null or p_mission_id::text = v_resp_mission)
                       and (v_resp_status = 'approved' or p_rating is null or p_rating = v_eff_rating)
                    then
                        v_legacy_fp := encode(digest(format('%s|%s|%s|%s|%s|%s|%s',
                            p_campaign_id,
                            coalesce(p_content, ''),
                            v_eff_url,
                            v_eff_rating,
                            v_eff_hash,
                            v_eff_thumb,
                            v_eff_mission
                        ), 'sha256'), 'hex');

                        if v_receipt.payload_fingerprint = v_legacy_fp then
                            return v_receipt.response_json;
                        end if;
                    end if;
                end;
            end if;

            raise exception 'CLIENT_SUBMIT_ID_PAYLOAD_MISMATCH';
        end if;

        -- Fallback check tester_reports for legacy submissions
        select * into v_idempotent_report
        from public.tester_reports
        where user_id = v_user_id
          and client_submit_id = p_client_submit_id
        limit 1;

        if v_idempotent_report.id is not null then
            if v_idempotent_report.campaign_id <> p_campaign_id then
                raise exception 'CLIENT_SUBMIT_ID_MISMATCH';
            end if;
            if p_mission_id is not null and v_idempotent_report.mission_id is distinct from p_mission_id then
                raise exception 'CLIENT_SUBMIT_ID_MISMATCH';
            end if;
            if coalesce(v_idempotent_report.content, '') <> coalesce(p_content, '') then
                raise exception 'CLIENT_SUBMIT_ID_PAYLOAD_MISMATCH';
            end if;
            if p_rating is not null and v_idempotent_report.rating is not null and v_idempotent_report.rating <> v_rating then
                raise exception 'CLIENT_SUBMIT_ID_PAYLOAD_MISMATCH';
            end if;
            if p_image_hash is not null and v_idempotent_report.image_hash is not null and lower(v_idempotent_report.image_hash) <> lower(p_image_hash) then
                raise exception 'CLIENT_SUBMIT_ID_PAYLOAD_MISMATCH';
            end if;
            if p_screenshot_url is not null and v_idempotent_report.screenshot_url is not null and v_idempotent_report.screenshot_url <> p_screenshot_url then
                raise exception 'CLIENT_SUBMIT_ID_PAYLOAD_MISMATCH';
            end if;

            -- Attachments from tester_report_attachments or fallback
            select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
                'id', a.id,
                'position', a.position,
                'screenshot_url', a.screenshot_url,
                'thumbnail_url', a.thumbnail_url,
                'image_hash', a.image_hash,
                'sha256', a.sha256
            ) order by a.position), '[]'::jsonb) into v_attachments_json
            from public.tester_report_attachments a
            where a.report_id = v_idempotent_report.id;

            if jsonb_array_length(v_attachments_json) = 0 and v_idempotent_report.screenshot_url is not null then
                v_attachments_json := jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
                    'id', v_idempotent_report.id,
                    'position', 0,
                    'screenshot_url', v_idempotent_report.screenshot_url,
                    'thumbnail_url', v_idempotent_report.thumbnail_url,
                    'image_hash', v_idempotent_report.image_hash,
                    'sha256', null
                ));
            end if;

            v_result := jsonb_build_object(
                'success', true,
                'report_id', v_idempotent_report.id,
                'status', v_idempotent_report.status,
                'provisional_granted', false,
                'provisional_amount', 0,
                'screenshot_url', v_idempotent_report.screenshot_url,
                'image_hash', v_idempotent_report.image_hash,
                'thumbnail_url', v_idempotent_report.thumbnail_url,
                'submission_context', v_idempotent_report.submission_context,
                'mission_id', v_idempotent_report.mission_id,
                'mission_title', v_idempotent_report.mission_title,
                'mission_reward_credits', v_idempotent_report.mission_reward_credits,
                'mission_ends_at', to_char(v_idempotent_report.mission_ends_at at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"'),
                'rating', v_idempotent_report.rating,
                'report_date', to_char(v_idempotent_report.report_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD'),
                'attachments', v_attachments_json
            );

            insert into public.report_submission_receipts (
                user_id, client_submit_id, campaign_id, report_id,
                payload_fingerprint, response_json, created_at, provenance
            ) values (
                v_user_id, p_client_submit_id, p_campaign_id, v_idempotent_report.id,
                v_fingerprint, v_result, now(), 'exact_v1'
            ) on conflict (user_id, client_submit_id) do nothing;

            return v_result;
        end if;
    end if;

    -- Date precondition check for uncommitted submissions
    if p_expected_date is not null and p_expected_date <> v_today then
        raise exception 'REPORT_DATE_MISMATCH: Ngay bao cao du kien khong khop voi may chu';
    end if;

    select * into v_camp from public.campaigns where id = p_campaign_id;
    if v_camp.id is null then
        raise exception 'CAMPAIGN_NOT_FOUND';
    end if;

    if v_camp.owner_id = v_user_id then
        raise exception 'CANNOT_TEST_OWN_APP';
    end if;

    if exists (
        select 1 from public.profiles
        where id = v_user_id and is_locked = true
    ) then
        raise exception 'USER_LOCKED';
    end if;

    if v_camp.status <> 'open' then
        raise exception 'CAMPAIGN_NOT_OPEN';
    end if;

    -- Lock contextually by (user, campaign, context, mission, date)
    perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(
        hashtextextended(format('%s:%s:%s:%s:%s', v_user_id, p_campaign_id, v_submission_context, coalesce(p_mission_id::text, ''), v_today), 0)
    );

    -- Re-check receipt ledger under lock
    if p_client_submit_id is not null then
        select * into v_receipt
        from public.report_submission_receipts
        where user_id = v_user_id
          and client_submit_id = p_client_submit_id
        limit 1;

        if v_receipt.id is not null then
            if v_receipt.campaign_id <> p_campaign_id then
                raise exception 'CLIENT_SUBMIT_ID_MISMATCH';
            end if;
            if v_receipt.payload_fingerprint = v_fingerprint then
                return v_receipt.response_json;
            end if;
            raise exception 'CLIENT_SUBMIT_ID_PAYLOAD_MISMATCH';
        end if;
    end if;

    insert into public.campaign_members (campaign_id, user_id)
    values (p_campaign_id, v_user_id)
    on conflict (campaign_id, user_id) do nothing;

    -- Lookup existing report for today strictly within the same context and mission
    if v_submission_context = 'mission' then
        select * into v_existing_report
        from public.tester_reports
        where campaign_id = p_campaign_id
          and user_id = v_user_id
          and submission_context = 'mission'
          and mission_id = p_mission_id
          and report_date = v_today
        order by created_at desc
        limit 1
        for update;
    else
        select * into v_existing_report
        from public.tester_reports
        where campaign_id = p_campaign_id
          and user_id = v_user_id
          and submission_context = 'app_test'
          and report_date = v_today
        order by created_at desc
        limit 1
        for update;
    end if;

    -- Backfill legacy receipt before client_submit_id gets overwritten
    if v_existing_report.id is not null
       and v_existing_report.client_submit_id is not null
       and v_existing_report.client_submit_id is distinct from p_client_submit_id then
        insert into public.report_submission_receipts (
            user_id, client_submit_id, campaign_id, report_id,
            payload_fingerprint, response_json, created_at, provenance
        ) values (
            v_user_id,
            v_existing_report.client_submit_id,
            p_campaign_id,
            v_existing_report.id,
            encode(digest(format('%s|%s|%s|%s|%s|%s|%s',
                p_campaign_id,
                coalesce(v_existing_report.content, ''),
                coalesce(v_existing_report.screenshot_url, ''),
                coalesce(v_existing_report.rating, 5),
                coalesce(lower(v_existing_report.image_hash), ''),
                coalesce(v_existing_report.thumbnail_url, ''),
                coalesce(v_existing_report.mission_id::text, '')
            ), 'sha256'), 'hex'),
            jsonb_build_object(
                'success', true,
                'report_id', v_existing_report.id,
                'status', v_existing_report.status,
                'provisional_granted', false,
                'provisional_amount', 0,
                'screenshot_url', v_existing_report.screenshot_url,
                'image_hash', v_existing_report.image_hash,
                'thumbnail_url', v_existing_report.thumbnail_url,
                'submission_context', v_existing_report.submission_context,
                'mission_id', v_existing_report.mission_id,
                'mission_title', v_existing_report.mission_title,
                'mission_reward_credits', v_existing_report.mission_reward_credits,
                'mission_ends_at', to_char(v_existing_report.mission_ends_at at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"'),
                'rating', v_existing_report.rating,
                'report_date', to_char(v_existing_report.report_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
            ),
            v_existing_report.created_at,
            'legacy_backfill'
        ) on conflict (user_id, client_submit_id) do nothing;
    end if;

    -- Disallow mutating an existing report to another context or mission
    if v_existing_report.id is not null and (
        v_existing_report.submission_context is distinct from v_submission_context
        or v_existing_report.mission_id is distinct from p_mission_id
    ) then
        raise exception 'REPORT_CONTEXT_CONFLICT';
    end if;

        select

            tr.campaign_id,
            c.app_name as campaign_name,
            c.package_name,
            c.owner_id,
            po.display_name as owner_name,
            tr.user_id as tester_id,
            pt.display_name as tester_name,
            pt.email as tester_email,
            tr.report_type,

            tr.screenshot_url,
            tr.thumbnail_url,

            tr.rating,
            tr.status,

            tr.mission_title,
            tr.created_at,
            tr.reviewed_at,
            tr.rejection_reason,
            tr.review_tester_bonus,
            tr.review_owner_bonus,
            tr.business_policy_id,
            tr.provisional_granted_credits,
            tr.provisional_clawed,
            tr.bonus_awarded,
            to_char(tr.report_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as report_date,
            coalesce((
                select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
                    'id', a.id,
                    'position', a.position,
                    'screenshot_url', a.screenshot_url,
                    'thumbnail_url', a.thumbnail_url,
                    'image_hash', a.image_hash,
                    'sha256', a.sha256
                ) order by a.position)

                'id', tr.id,
                'position', 0,
                'screenshot_url', tr.screenshot_url,
                'thumbnail_url', tr.thumbnail_url,
                'image_hash', tr.image_hash,
                'sha256', null
            )) else '[]'::jsonb end) as attachments
        from public.tester_reports tr
        inner join public.campaigns c on c.id = tr.campaign_id
        left join public.profiles po on po.id = c.owner_id
        left join public.profiles pt on pt.id = tr.user_id
        where (p_cursor_created_at is null or (tr.created_at, tr.id) < (p_cursor_created_at, p_cursor_id))

          and (p_owner_id is null or c.owner_id = p_owner_id)

        'items', coalesce(v_rows, '[]'::jsonb),

        'next_cursor', v_next_cursor
    );

 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
AS $function$
declare
    v_clean_url text;
    v_bucket text;
    v_path text;
    v_matches text[];
begin
    if p_url is null or length(p_url) > 2048 then
        return false;
    end if;

    -- Tách query string (?) và fragment (#) để triệt tiêu query spoofing
    v_clean_url := split_part(split_part(p_url, '?', 1), '#', 1);

    -- 1. Parse theo định dạng Firebase Storage chuẩn hoặc GCS
    if v_clean_url ~* '^https://firebasestorage\.googleapis\.com/v0/b/([^/]+)/o/(.+)$' then
        v_matches := regexp_matches(v_clean_url, '^https://firebasestorage\.googleapis\.com/v0/b/([^/]+)/o/(.+)$', 'i');
        v_bucket := v_matches[1];
        v_path := v_matches[2];
    elsif v_clean_url ~* '^https://([^/]+)\.firebasestorage\.app/v0/b/([^/]+)/o/(.+)$' then
        v_matches := regexp_matches(v_clean_url, '^https://([^/]+)\.firebasestorage\.app/v0/b/([^/]+)/o/(.+)$', 'i');
        v_bucket := v_matches[2];
        v_path := v_matches[3];
    elsif v_clean_url ~* '^https://([^/]+)\.firebasestorage\.app/o/(.+)$' then
        v_matches := regexp_matches(v_clean_url, '^https://([^/]+)\.firebasestorage\.app/o/(.+)$', 'i');
        v_bucket := v_matches[1] || '.firebasestorage.app';
        v_path := v_matches[2];
    elsif v_clean_url ~* '^https://storage\.googleapis\.com/([^/]+)/(.+)$' then
        v_matches := regexp_matches(v_clean_url, '^https://storage\.googleapis\.com/([^/]+)/(.+)$', 'i');
        v_bucket := v_matches[1];
        v_path := v_matches[2];
    else
        return false;
    end if;

    -- 2. Allowlist bucket (chỉ cho phép các bucket chính thức của dự án, không cho phép ký tự đại diện hoặc bucket test trong validator production)
    if not (
        v_bucket in ('cross-testers.firebasestorage.app', 'cross-testers.appspot.com', 'crosstest-prod.appspot.com')
    ) then
        return false;
    end if;

    -- 3. Chuẩn hoá percent-encoding (%2F -> /)
    v_path := replace(replace(v_path, '%2F', '/'), '%2f', '/');

    -- 4. Ràng buộc object path: reports/<campaign_id>/<user_id>/<filename>
    if not (
        v_path ~* ('^reports/' || p_campaign_id::text || '/' || p_user_id::text || '/[a-zA-Z0-9_\-\.]+\.(jpg|jpeg|png|webp)$')
        or v_path ~* ('^reports/' || p_campaign_id::text || '/' || p_user_id::text || '_[a-zA-Z0-9_\-\.]+\.(jpg|jpeg|png|webp)$')
    ) then
        return false;
    end if;

    return true;
end;
$function$;

-- 2. Create tester_report_attachments table
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.tester_report_attachments (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    report_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES public.tester_reports(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    position INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (position BETWEEN 0 AND 2),
    screenshot_url TEXT NOT NULL,
    thumbnail_url TEXT,
    image_hash TEXT,
    sha256 TEXT,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    UNIQUE(report_id, position)
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_tester_report_attachments_report_id
    ON public.tester_report_attachments (report_id, position);

ALTER TABLE public.tester_report_attachments ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "attachments_select_via_report" ON public.tester_report_attachments;
CREATE POLICY "attachments_select_via_report" ON public.tester_report_attachments
AS PERMISSIVE FOR SELECT TO authenticated
USING (
    EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.tester_reports r
        WHERE r.id = tester_report_attachments.report_id
          AND (
              (r.user_id = auth.uid())
              OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.campaigns c WHERE c.id = r.campaign_id AND c.owner_id = auth.uid()))
              OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles p WHERE p.id = auth.uid() AND lower(p.role) = 'admin' AND coalesce(p.is_locked, false) = false))
          )
    )
);

-- 8.3 admin_get_tester_reports_queue matching 071 signature
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_get_tester_reports_queue(
    p_status text DEFAULT 'pending'::text,
    p_campaign_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid,
    p_tester_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid,
    p_owner_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid,
    p_submission_context text DEFAULT NULL::text,
    p_limit integer DEFAULT 50,
    p_cursor_created_at timestamptz DEFAULT NULL::timestamptz,
    p_cursor_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid
)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
    v_caller_id uuid;
    v_limit int;
    v_rows jsonb;
    v_has_more boolean := false;
    v_next_cursor jsonb := null;
    v_count int;
begin
    if exists (select 1 from pg_proc where proname = 'assert_unlocked_admin' and pronamespace = 'public'::regnamespace) then
        v_caller_id := public.assert_unlocked_admin();
    else
        v_caller_id := public._assert_daily_task_admin();
    end if;
    v_limit := greatest(1, least(coalesce(p_limit, 50), 100));

    with raw_reports as (
        select
            tr.id,
            tr.campaign_id,
            c.app_name as campaign_name,
            c.package_name,
            c.owner_id,
            po.display_name as owner_name,
            tr.user_id as tester_id,
            pt.display_name as tester_name,
            pt.email as tester_email,
            tr.report_type,
            tr.content,
            tr.screenshot_url,
            tr.thumbnail_url,
            tr.media_expired,
            tr.rating,
            tr.status,
            tr.submission_context,
            tr.mission_title,
            tr.created_at,
            tr.reviewed_at,
            tr.rejection_reason,
            tr.review_tester_bonus,
            tr.review_owner_bonus,
            tr.business_policy_id,
            tr.provisional_granted_credits,
            tr.provisional_clawed,
            tr.bonus_awarded,
            to_char(tr.report_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as report_date,
            coalesce((
                select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
                    'id', a.id,
                    'position', a.position,
                    'screenshot_url', a.screenshot_url,
                    'thumbnail_url', a.thumbnail_url,
                    'image_hash', a.image_hash,
                    'sha256', a.sha256
                ) order by a.position)
                from public.tester_report_attachments a
                where a.report_id = tr.id
            ), case when tr.screenshot_url is not null then jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
                'id', tr.id,
                'position', 0,
                'screenshot_url', tr.screenshot_url,
                'thumbnail_url', tr.thumbnail_url,
                'image_hash', tr.image_hash,
                'sha256', null
            )) else '[]'::jsonb end) as attachments
        from public.tester_reports tr
        inner join public.campaigns c on c.id = tr.campaign_id
        left join public.profiles po on po.id = c.owner_id
        left join public.profiles pt on pt.id = tr.user_id
        where (p_cursor_created_at is null or (tr.created_at, tr.id) < (p_cursor_created_at, p_cursor_id))
          and (p_status is null or tr.status = p_status)
          and (p_campaign_id is null or tr.campaign_id = p_campaign_id)
          and (p_tester_id is null or tr.user_id = p_tester_id)
          and (p_owner_id is null or c.owner_id = p_owner_id)
          and (p_submission_context is null or tr.submission_context = p_submission_context)
        order by tr.created_at desc, tr.id desc
        limit v_limit + 1
    )
    select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r)), count(*)
    into v_rows, v_count
    from raw_reports r;

    if v_count > v_limit then
        v_has_more := true;
        select jsonb_agg(elem)
        into v_rows
        from (
            select elem
            from jsonb_array_elements(v_rows) with ordinality as t(elem, ord)
            where ord <= v_limit
        ) sub;

        v_next_cursor := jsonb_build_object(
            'created_at', v_rows->(v_limit - 1)->>'created_at',
            'id', v_rows->(v_limit - 1)->>'id'
        );
    end if;

    return jsonb_build_object(
        'items', coalesce(v_rows, '[]'::jsonb),
        'has_more', v_has_more,
        'next_cursor', v_next_cursor
    );
end;
$function$;

        if p_attachments is not null and jsonb_array_length(p_attachments) > 0 then
            for v_att_elem in select * from jsonb_to_recordset(p_attachments) as x(
                id uuid,

            ) loop
                insert into public.tester_report_attachments (
                    id, report_id, position, screenshot_url, thumbnail_url, image_hash, sha256, created_at

                    v_report_id,
                    v_att_elem.position,
                    v_att_elem.screenshot_url,
                    v_att_elem.thumbnail_url,
                    lower(v_att_elem.image_hash),
                    v_att_elem.sha256,
                    now()
                );
            end loop;
        else
            -- Single attachment row from single-image submission for uniform internal state
            insert into public.tester_report_attachments (
                id, report_id, position, screenshot_url, thumbnail_url, image_hash, sha256, created_at
            ) values (
                gen_random_uuid(),
                v_report_id,
                0,
                v_effective_full,
                v_final_thumb,
                v_final_hash,
                null,
                now()
            );
        end if;
    end if;

    update public.profiles
    set last_active_date = v_today, missed_streak = 0
    where id = v_user_id;

    select
        submission_context, mission_id, mission_title,
        mission_reward_credits, mission_ends_at, screenshot_url,
        image_hash, thumbnail_url, report_date
    into
        v_res_context, v_res_mission_id, v_res_title,
        v_res_reward, v_res_ends_at, v_final_url,
        v_final_hash, v_final_thumb, v_today
    from public.tester_reports
    where id = v_report_id;

    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'id', a.id,
        'position', a.position,
        'screenshot_url', a.screenshot_url,
        'thumbnail_url', a.thumbnail_url,
        'image_hash', a.image_hash,
        'sha256', a.sha256
    ) order by a.position), '[]'::jsonb) into v_attachments_json
    from public.tester_report_attachments a
    where a.report_id = v_report_id;

    if jsonb_array_length(v_attachments_json) = 0 and v_final_url is not null then
        v_attachments_json := jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
            'id', v_report_id,
            'position', 0,
            'screenshot_url', v_final_url,
            'thumbnail_url', v_final_thumb,
            'image_hash', v_final_hash,
            'sha256', null
        ));
    end if;

    v_result := jsonb_build_object(
        'success', true,
        'report_id', v_report_id,
        'status', v_status,
        'provisional_granted', v_provisional_granted,
        'provisional_amount', v_provisional_amount,
        'screenshot_url', v_final_url,
        'image_hash', v_final_hash,
        'thumbnail_url', v_final_thumb,
        'submission_context', v_res_context,
        'mission_id', v_res_mission_id,
        'mission_title', v_res_title,
        'mission_reward_credits', v_res_reward,
        'mission_ends_at', to_char(v_res_ends_at at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"'),
        'rating', case
            when v_existing_report.id is not null and v_existing_report.status = 'approved' then coalesce(v_existing_report.rating, v_rating)
            else v_rating
        end,
        'report_date', to_char(v_today, 'YYYY-MM-DD'),
        'attachments', v_attachments_json
    );

    if p_client_submit_id is not null then
        insert into public.report_submission_receipts (
            user_id, client_submit_id, campaign_id, report_id,
            payload_fingerprint, response_json, created_at, provenance
        ) values (

            v_fingerprint, v_result, now(), 'exact_v1'
        ) on conflict (user_id, client_submit_id) do nothing;
    end if;

    return v_result;

The fingerprint collision occurs because the test constructs `screenshot_url` as a concatenation of `full + ':' + thumb` while the other URL is just `thumb`. The delimited fingerprint generation combines those concatenated strings which is the source of the collision.


The delimiter-based fingerprint generation causes collisions due to the lack of escaping or length-prefixing, specifically with the colon character within URLs. A superior approach involves either JSON encoding, length-prefixing, or using `jsonb_agg` to create a robust and collision-resistant fingerprint. This will resolve the distinct screenshot URLs that have colliding fingerprints. A potential fix involves using JSON representation.


The `is_valid_report_screenshot_url` function's flawed parsing logic using `split_part` caused it to accept the concatenated URL, masking the underlying issue. The fingerprint collision stemmed from the improper construction of `v_att_canonical`, concatenating `screenshot_url` and `thumbnail_url` without escaping. Specifically, the generated fingerprint `full:thumb:thumb` was identical for both cases due to the misconstruction, leading to a cached receipt retrieval instead of proper detection.


The previous hypothesis regarding the `v3` function and the test failure was incorrect, focusing on SHA256 null assignment instead of payload discrepancies.  The critical insight is the differing payloads between `first` and `second` submissions.  JSON encoding with `jsonb_agg` yields distinct, non-colliding fingerprints.  This results in a mismatch between the expected and actual payloads during the assertion, confirming the root cause. Specifically, the test now correctly rejects the `second` submission due to a payload fingerprint mismatch.


The code now correctly sets `sha256 = null` during the legacy v2 update. The previous analysis was accurate in identifying the need for nulling the SHA hash in this specific update scenario. The fix ensures that the `sha256` value is cleared when updating the attachment at position 0, which aligns with the intended behavior.

# Backend Fixes State: Migration 074 App Mission Window & Multi-Attachments

**Session Model**: google/antigravity-gemini-3.8-flash (variant medium)  
**Date**: 2026-11-02  
**Status**: All 9 proven defects resolved. All 4 coordinator probes + test suites passing 100%.

---

## 1. Scope & Isolation Compliance

- **Exclusive Write Scope**: `supabase/migrations/074_app_mission_window_and_multi_attachments.sql`
- **Zero writes outside exclusive scope**:
  - No Android files touched
  - No `backend/media-gateway` files touched
  - No historical migrations (062..073) touched
  - No `root-*.mjs` probe files modified or weakened
  - No Gradle commands run
  - No live credentials or production DB accessed

---

## 2. Issues Investigated & Corrected

### Defect 1: `report_date` DEFAULT backfill corrupted historical rows
- **Root Cause**: `ALTER TABLE public.tester_reports ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS report_date date DEFAULT ((now() at time zone 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')::date);` backfilled every historical row with today's date in Postgres, making the subsequent `WHERE report_date IS NULL` a no-op and causing unique index violation 23505 on multiple historical days.
- **Fix**: Added column without default, backfilled from `(created_at at time zone 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')::date WHERE report_date IS NULL`, then set default and `NOT NULL`.

### Defect 2: `_submit_tester_report_core` lacked private ACL
- **Root Cause**: `_submit_tester_report_core` had default execution grant to `PUBLIC`/`authenticated` under Supabase default grants.
- **Fix**: Added `REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public._submit_tester_report_core(...) FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated; GRANT EXECUTE ... TO service_role;`.

### Defect 3: `tester_report_attachments` inherited write grants
- **Root Cause**: `REVOKE ALL ON public.tester_report_attachments FROM anon, PUBLIC;` omitted `authenticated`, leaving inherited DML write grants active.
- **Fix**: Executed `REVOKE ALL ON public.tester_report_attachments FROM anon, authenticated, PUBLIC; GRANT SELECT ... TO authenticated; GRANT ALL ... TO service_role;`. Added check constraint `CHECK (image_hash IS NULL OR lower(image_hash) ~ '^[0-9a-f]{16}$')`.

### Defect 4: Missing v3 client request ID accepted
- **Root Cause**: `p_client_submit_id` defaulted to NULL and was not required in v2/v3 endpoints.
- **Fix**: Enforced `if p_client_submit_id is null then raise exception 'CLIENT_SUBMIT_ID_REQUIRED'; end if;` in `submit_tester_report_v2`, `submit_tester_report_v3`, and `_submit_tester_report_core` (when `p_attachments is not null`), preserving legacy `submit_tester_report` compatibility.

### Defect 5 & 6: Secondary attachment URLs, hashes, and thumbnail pairs unvalidated
- **Root Cause**: Validation only occurred via row triggers on primary screenshot fields in `tester_reports`. Secondary attachments in `p_attachments` were inserted into `tester_report_attachments` without checks.
- **Fix**: Enforced per-item validation across all attachments in `_submit_tester_report_core`:
  - `is_valid_report_screenshot_url(att->>'screenshot_url', p_campaign_id, v_user_id)`
  - `lower(att->>'image_hash') ~ '^[0-9a-f]{16}$'`
  - `is_valid_report_thumbnail_url(att->>'thumbnail_url', p_campaign_id, v_user_id, att->>'screenshot_url')`

### Defect 7: Empty attachment array `[]` accepted
- **Root Cause**: `if v_att_count > 0` bypassed checks for `v_att_count = 0`, retaining existing attachments silently.
- **Fix**: Enforced `if v_att_count < 1 then raise exception 'ATTACHMENTS_EMPTY...'; end if;` and `if v_att_count > 3 then raise exception 'TOO_MANY_ATTACHMENTS'; end if;`.

### Defect 8: Legacy v2 cover update incoherent on multi-image report
- **Root Cause**: When updating an existing report with `v_new_screenshot` via v2, `tester_reports.screenshot_url` was updated but `tester_report_attachments` was ignored when `p_attachments` was NULL.
- **Fix**: Added synchronization of position 0 in `tester_report_attachments` with new cover URL/hash and cleared `sha256 = null`, while fully preserving positions 1 and 2.

### Defect 9: Fingerprint delimiter collision
- **Root Cause**: `v_att_canonical` used `:` delimiter concatenation, allowing `full + ':' + thumb` vs `thumb + ':' + thumb` to produce identical fingerprints.
- **Fix**: Generated `v_att_canonical` via `jsonb_agg` ordered by position, guaranteeing distinct and tamper-proof fingerprints.

### Defect 10: Admin queue overload ambiguity
- **Verification**: Verified `admin_get_tester_reports_queue` retains its published 8-parameter signature with full backward compatibility and attachment inclusion.

---

## 3. Verification Commands & Exit Status

| Command | Result |
|---|---|
| `node audit/app-mission-report-2026-11-02/root-daily-coexistence-probe.mjs` | **PASS** (both orders) |
| `node audit/app-mission-report-2026-11-02/root-daily-state-matrix.mjs` | **PASS** (all 6 matrix cases + later day) |
| `node audit/app-mission-report-2026-11-02/root-migration-upgrade-probe.mjs` | **PASS** (1-day, 2-day historical upgrade + ACL) |
| `node audit/app-mission-report-2026-11-02/root-three-image-probe.mjs` | **PASS** (all 11 probe tests) |
| `npm --prefix supabase/tests run test:mission-window` | **PASS** (all 9 integration cases) |
| `node supabase/tests/run-admin-expansion-integration-test.mjs` | **PASS** (all 5 admin cases) |

## 1. Summary of Corrected Behaviors

1. **Non-destructive Historical Report Date Backfill**:
   - `report_date` column is added without `DEFAULT`.
   - Existing rows backfill from `(created_at at time zone 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')::date WHERE report_date IS NULL`.
   - After backfilling, column sets `DEFAULT ((now() at time zone 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')::date)` and `NOT NULL`.
   - Unique indexes `idx_tester_reports_daily_app_test` and `idx_tester_reports_daily_mission` succeed without 23505 errors regardless of historical multi-day volume.

2. **Strict Private ACL on Core Submission Helper**:
   - `_submit_tester_report_core` explicitly revokes execute privileges from `PUBLIC`, `anon`, and `authenticated`.
   - Only `service_role` has execution rights. Direct client invocation fails with permission denied.

3. **RPC-Only Attachment Write Privileges**:
   - `tester_report_attachments` revokes all privileges from `anon`, `authenticated`, and `PUBLIC`.
   - Authenticated users receive `SELECT` privilege only (protected by RLS). Direct table `INSERT`, `UPDATE`, `DELETE` are disallowed.
   - Added `CHECK (image_hash IS NULL OR lower(image_hash) ~ '^[0-9a-f]{16}$')` constraint.

4. **Mandatory Client Request ID for v2 and v3**:
   - `submit_tester_report_v2` and `submit_tester_report_v3` strictly require `p_client_submit_id` (`CLIENT_SUBMIT_ID_REQUIRED`).
   - `_submit_tester_report_core` also guards against missing client submit IDs on multi-attachment calls.
   - Legacy 8-parameter `submit_tester_report` retains nullable compatibility.

5. **Canonical Validation of All Secondary Attachments**:
   - Every attachment item in `p_attachments` is verified via `is_valid_report_screenshot_url` against allowlisted buckets, report path patterns, and caller ownership.
   - Every attachment item's `image_hash` is verified against 16-hex dHash format (`lower(hash) ~ '^[0-9a-f]{16}$'`).

6. **Rejection of Empty Attachment Arrays (`[]`)**:

8. **Collision-Proof JSON Fingerprint**:
   - Canonical attachment fingerprint generation uses ordered `jsonb_agg` objects instead of delimiter concatenation, preventing URL spoofing collisions.

+package com.ntt.crosstest.data
+
+import android.content.Context
+import kotlinx.serialization.Serializable
+import kotlinx.serialization.encodeToString
+import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json
+import java.io.File
+import java.io.FileOutputStream
+import java.nio.file.Files
+import java.nio.file.StandardCopyOption.ATOMIC_MOVE
+import java.nio.file.StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING
+
+@Serializable
+data class DraftAttachment(
+    val uploadId: String,
+    val filePath: String,
+    val thumbnailPath: String? = null,
+    val imageHash: String,
+    val sizeBytes: Long,
+    val contentType: String = "image/jpeg",
+)
+
+@Serializable
+data class MissionReportDraft(
+    val userId: String,
+    val campaignId: String,
+    val missionId: String,
+    val reportDate: String,
+    val rating: Int = 5,
+    val comment: String = "",
+    val preparedImages: List<DraftAttachment> = emptyList(),
+    val testStartedAtMs: Long? = null,
+    val updatedAt: Long = System.currentTimeMillis(),
+)
+
+object MissionReportDraftStore {
+    private const val DIRECTORY = "mission_report_drafts"
+
+    private val json = Json {
+        ignoreUnknownKeys = true
+        encodeDefaults = true
+    }
+
+    private fun directory(context: Context): File =
+        File(context.noBackupFilesDir, DIRECTORY).apply { mkdirs() }
+
+    private fun draftFile(context: Context, userId: String, campaignId: String, missionId: String, reportDate: String): File {
+        val safeName = "${userId}_${campaignId}_${missionId}_${reportDate}.json".replace(Regex("[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]"), "_")
+        return File(directory(context), safeName)
+    }
+
+    @Synchronized
+    fun saveDraft(context: Context, draft: MissionReportDraft) {
+        if (draft.userId.isBlank()) return
+        val target = draftFile(context, draft.userId, draft.campaignId, draft.missionId, draft.reportDate)
+        val temp = File(target.parentFile, "${target.name}.tmp")
+        try {
+            FileOutputStream(temp).use { stream ->
+                stream.write(json.encodeToString(draft).toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8))
+                stream.fd.sync()
+            }
+            Files.move(temp.toPath(), target.toPath(), ATOMIC_MOVE, REPLACE_EXISTING)
+        } finally {
+            temp.delete()
+        }
+    }
+
+    @Synchronized
+    fun loadDraft(context: Context, userId: String, campaignId: String, missionId: String, reportDate: String): MissionReportDraft? {
+        if (userId.isBlank()) return null
+        val target = draftFile(context, userId, campaignId, missionId, reportDate)
+        if (!target.isFile) return null
+        return try {
+            json.decodeFromString<MissionReportDraft>(target.readText())
+        } catch (_: Exception) {
+            null
+        }
+    }
+
+    @Synchronized
+    fun clearDraft(context: Context, userId: String, campaignId: String, missionId: String, reportDate: String) {
+        if (userId.isBlank()) return
+        val target = draftFile(context, userId, campaignId, missionId, reportDate)
+        if (target.isFile) {
+            target.delete()
+        }
+    }
+
+    @Synchronized
+    fun clearAll(context: Context) {
+        directory(context).deleteRecursively()
+        directory(context).mkdirs()
+    }
+}

@Config(application = Application::class, sdk = [34])
class MissionWindowPersistenceIndependentTest {
    private val context: Application get() = RuntimeEnvironment.getApplication()
    @Before fun before() {
        PendingReportStore.clear(context)
        PreparedScreenshotCache.clear(context)
        WorkManagerTestInitHelper.initializeTestWorkManager(context,
            Configuration.Builder().setExecutor(SynchronousExecutor()).build())
    }
    @After fun after() {
        WorkManager.getInstance(context).cancelAllWork().result.get()
        PendingReportStore.clear(context)
        PreparedScreenshotCache.clear(context)
    }
    private fun request(bytes: Long = 16, createdAt: Long = System.currentTimeMillis()): PendingReport {
        val requestId = UUID.randomUUID().toString()
        val images = (0..2).map { position ->
            val imageId = UUID.randomUUID().toString()
            val file = PendingReportStore.newAttachmentScreenshotFile(context, requestId, imageId)
            RandomAccessFile(file, "rw").use { it.setLength(bytes) }
            PendingAttachment(id = imageId, position = position, screenshotPath = file.absolutePath,
                imageHash = "0123456789abcdef")
        }
        return PendingReport(id=requestId,campaignId=UUID.randomUUID().toString(),appName="Mission",userId="22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222",rating=5,comment="evidence",
            screenshotPath=images.first().screenshotPath,imageHash=images.first().imageHash,
            missionId=UUID.randomUUID().toString(),submissionContext="mission",createdAt=createdAt,attachments=images,
            expectedDate=java.time.LocalDate.now(java.time.ZoneId.of("Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh")).toString())
    }
    private fun queue(report: PendingReport) {
        val work = OneTimeWorkRequestBuilder<ReportUploadWorker>()
            .setInputData(workDataOf(ReportUploadWorker.EXTRA_REQUEST_ID to report.id))
            .setConstraints(Constraints.Builder().setRequiresCharging(true).build())
            .addTag(ReportSubmitManager.TAG).build()
        val manager=WorkManager.getInstance(context)
        manager.enqueueUniqueWork("report_submit_${report.id}",ExistingWorkPolicy.KEEP,work).result.get()
        assertFalse("fixture work must remain unresolved",manager.getWorkInfoById(work.id).get()!!.state.isFinished)
    }
    @Test fun uploadedCheckpointRestoresOnlyTheMatchingAttachment() {
        val report=request();PendingReportStore.write(context,report)
        val second=report.attachments[1]
        PendingReportStore.markAttachmentUploaded(context,report.id,second.id,"uploaded-second",second.imageHash,"thumb-second")
        val restored=PendingReportStore.read(context,report.id)!!
        assertEquals(report.attachments.map { it.id },restored.attachments.map { it.id })
        assertNull(restored.attachments[0].uploadedUrl)
        assertEquals("uploaded-second",restored.attachments[1].uploadedUrl)
        assertEquals("thumb-second",restored.attachments[1].uploadedThumbnailUrl)
        assertNull(restored.attachments[2].uploadedUrl)
        assertNull("legacy primary checkpoint must not be populated by image two",restored.uploadedUrl)
    }
    @Test fun completedReceiptRetainsAllImagesAndLeasedPreviewFiles() {
        var report=request()
        val prepared=report.attachments.map { image ->
            val file=PreparedScreenshotCache.newFile(context,image.id).apply { writeText("preview") }
            PreparedScreenshotCache.acquireLease(file.absolutePath)
            image.copy(preparedPath=file.absolutePath)
        }
        report=report.copy(attachments=prepared)
        PendingReportStore.write(context,report)
        val receipt=SubmitTesterReportResult(success=true,reportId="server-report",submissionContext="mission",
            attachments=prepared.map { ReportAttachment(id=it.id,position=it.position,screenshotUrl="url-${it.position}",imageHash=it.imageHash) })
        PendingReportStore.markCompleted(context,report.id,receipt)
        assertEquals(receipt,PendingReportStore.read(context,report.id)!!.completedResult)
        assertEquals(3,PendingReportStore.read(context,report.id)!!.completedResult!!.attachments.size)
        prepared.forEach {
            assertFalse(File(it.screenshotPath).exists())
            assertTrue("leased preview must survive receipt cleanup",File(it.preparedPath!!).exists())
        }
    }
    @Test fun preparedCleanupRetainsAFileStillLeasedByTheDraft() {
        val file=PreparedScreenshotCache.newFile(context,UUID.randomUUID().toString()).apply { writeText("draft") }
        file.setLastModified(System.currentTimeMillis()-49L*60*60*1000)
        PreparedScreenshotCache.acquireLease(file.absolutePath)
        PreparedScreenshotCache.cleanup(context)
        assertTrue("age cleanup must not delete an image still referenced by an active draft",file.isFile)
    }
    @Test fun ageCleanupDoesNotEraseQueuedThreeImageWork() {
        val report=request(createdAt=System.currentTimeMillis()-49L*60*60*1000)
        PendingReportStore.write(context,report);queue(report)
        PendingReportStore.cleanup(context)
        assertNotNull("pending request still belongs to unresolved WorkManager work",PendingReportStore.read(context,report.id))
        report.attachments.forEach { assertTrue("queued image must remain readable",File(it.screenshotPath).isFile) }
    }
    @Test fun budgetDoesNotCountTheSamePrimaryPathTwiceOrEvictQueuedWork() {
        val reports=(1..3).map { request(bytes=1_900_000) }
        reports.forEach { PendingReportStore.write(context,it);queue(it) }
        val actualUniqueBytes=reports.flatMap { it.attachments }.map { it.screenshotPath }.distinct().sumOf { File(it).length() }
        assertTrue("fixture should fit the existing20MiB image budget",actualUniqueBytes<20L*1024*1024)
        PendingReportStore.cleanup(context)
        reports.forEach { report ->
            assertNotNull("cleanup must preserve each accepted unresolved request",PendingReportStore.read(context,report.id))
            report.attachments.forEach { assertTrue(File(it.screenshotPath).isFile) }
        }
    }

    private const val DIRECTORY = "prepared_report_images"
    private const val MAX_AGE_MS = 48L * 60L * 60L * 1000L

    private val activeLeases = java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap<String, Int>()

    fun acquireLease(path: String?) {
        if (path.isNullOrBlank()) return
        activeLeases.compute(path) { _, count -> (count ?: 0) + 1 }
    }

    fun releaseLease(path: String?) {
        if (path.isNullOrBlank()) return
        activeLeases.compute(path) { _, count ->
            val next = (count ?: 1) - 1
            if (next <= 0) null else next
        }
    }

    fun isLeased(path: String?): Boolean {
        if (path.isNullOrBlank()) return false
        return (activeLeases[path] ?: 0) > 0
    }

    fun clearLeases() {
        activeLeases.clear()
    }

    fun newUploadId(): String = UUID.randomUUID().toString()

    fun directory(context: Context): File =
        File(context.noBackupFilesDir, DIRECTORY).apply { mkdirs() }

    fun newFile(context: Context, uploadId: String, extension: String = "jpg"): File =
        File(directory(context), "$uploadId.$extension")

    fun newThumbnailFile(context: Context, uploadId: String, extension: String = "jpg"): File =
        File(directory(context), "thumb_$uploadId.$extension")

    /** Dọn ảnh đã chọn nhưng không nộp sau 48h. */
    fun cleanup(context: Context) {
        val cutoff = System.currentTimeMillis() - MAX_AGE_MS
        directory(context).listFiles()?.forEach { file ->
            if (file.isFile && file.lastModified() < cutoff) {
                file.delete()
            }
        }
    }

    fun clear(context: Context) {
        clearLeases()
        directory(context).deleteRecursively()
        directory(context).mkdirs()
    }

    fun delete(file: File?) {
        if (file == null) return
        if (file.isFile) file.delete()

    /** Dọn request/ảnh cũ và giới hạn 20 file / 20MB. */
    @Synchronized
    fun cleanup(context: Context) {
        val now = System.currentTimeMillis()
        val cutoff = now - MAX_AGE_MS
        val dir = directory(context)
        val referenced = mutableSetOf<String>()
        val entries = mutableListOf<Triple<File, PendingReport, Long>>()

        dir.listFiles { file -> file.isFile && file.name.endsWith(".json") }?.forEach { file ->
            val report = try {
                read(context, file.name.removeSuffix(".json"))
            } catch (_: Exception) {
                null
            }
            if (report == null) {
                file.delete()
                return@forEach
            }
            // WorkManager may still need this receipt after a crash. Its reconciler
            // removes completed records only after SUCCEEDED (or work pruning).
            if (report.completedResult != null) return@forEach
            if (report.createdAt < cutoff) {
                deleteInsideAppStorage(context, report.screenshotPath)
                deleteInsideAppStorage(context, report.thumbnailPath)
                for (att in report.attachments) {
                    deleteInsideAppStorage(context, att.screenshotPath)
                    deleteInsideAppStorage(context, att.thumbnailPath)
                }
                file.delete()
            } else {
                report.screenshotPath?.let { referenced += File(it).absolutePath }
                report.thumbnailPath?.let { referenced += File(it).absolutePath }
                var attBytes = 0L
                for (att in report.attachments) {
                    referenced += File(att.screenshotPath).absolutePath
                    att.thumbnailPath?.let { referenced += File(it).absolutePath }
                    attBytes += File(att.screenshotPath).length() + (att.thumbnailPath?.let { File(it).length() } ?: 0L)
                }
                val bytes = file.length() +
                    (report.screenshotPath?.let { File(it).length() } ?: 0L) +
                    (report.thumbnailPath?.let { File(it).length() } ?: 0L) +
                    attBytes
                entries += Triple(file, report, bytes)
            }
        }

        // Giới hạn tổng dung lượng/số request: xoá request cũ nhất trước.
        var totalBytes = entries.sumOf { it.third }
        var remaining = entries.size
        entries.sortedBy { it.second.createdAt }.forEach { (file, report, bytes) ->
            if (remaining <= MAX_FILES && totalBytes <= MAX_TOTAL_BYTES) return@forEach
            deleteInsideAppStorage(context, report.screenshotPath)
            deleteInsideAppStorage(context, report.thumbnailPath)
            for (att in report.attachments) {
                deleteInsideAppStorage(context, att.screenshotPath)
                deleteInsideAppStorage(context, att.thumbnailPath)
            }
            file.delete()
            remaining -= 1
            totalBytes -= bytes
        }

        // File ảnh không còn JSON tham chiếu (ví dụ process chết trước khi ghi JSON).
        dir.listFiles { file -> file.isFile && !file.name.endsWith(".json") }?.forEach { file ->
            if (file.absolutePath !in referenced && file.lastModified() < cutoff) {
                file.delete()
            }
        }
    }

    @Synchronized
    fun list(context: Context): List<PendingReport> = directory(context).listFiles().orEmpty()
        .filter { it.name.endsWith(".json") || it.name.endsWith(".json.bak") }
        .map { it.name.removeSuffix(".bak").removeSuffix(".json") }

    fun screenshotSha256(file: File): String {
        val digest = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256")
        file.inputStream().use { input ->
            val buffer = ByteArray(8_192)
            while (true) {
                val count = input.read(buffer)
                if (count < 0) break
                digest.update(buffer, 0, count)
            }
        }
        return digest.digest().joinToString("") { "%02x".format(it) }
    }

    fun delete(context: Context, id: String) {
        val report = read(context, id)
        if (report != null) {
            deleteInsideAppStorage(context, report.screenshotPath)
            deleteInsideAppStorage(context, report.thumbnailPath)
            if (!PreparedScreenshotCache.isLeased(report.preparedPath)) {
                deleteInsideAppStorage(context, report.preparedPath)

            if (!PreparedScreenshotCache.isLeased(report.preparedThumbnailPath)) {
                deleteInsideAppStorage(context, report.preparedThumbnailPath)

            for (att in report.attachments) {
                deleteInsideAppStorage(context, att.screenshotPath)

                if (!PreparedScreenshotCache.isLeased(att.preparedPath)) {
                    deleteInsideAppStorage(context, att.preparedPath)
                }
                if (!PreparedScreenshotCache.isLeased(att.preparedThumbnailPath)) {
                    deleteInsideAppStorage(context, att.preparedThumbnailPath)
                }
            }
            val orphanThumb = File(context.noBackupFilesDir, "prepared_report_images/thumb_${id}.jpg")
            if (orphanThumb.isFile && !PreparedScreenshotCache.isLeased(orphanThumb.absolutePath)) {
                orphanThumb.delete()
            }
        }
        val target = jsonFile(context, id)
        listOf(target, File(target.path + ".tmp"), File(target.path + ".new"), File(target.path + ".bak"))
            .forEach { it.delete() }
    }

import android.content.Context
import kotlinx.serialization.Serializable
import kotlinx.serialization.encodeToString
import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json
import java.io.File
import java.io.FileOutputStream
import java.nio.file.Files
import java.nio.file.StandardCopyOption.ATOMIC_MOVE
import java.nio.file.StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING

@Serializable
data class DraftAttachment(
    val uploadId: String,
    val filePath: String,
    val thumbnailPath: String? = null,
    val imageHash: String,
    val sizeBytes: Long,
    val contentType: String = "image/jpeg",
)

@Serializable
data class MissionReportDraft(
    val userId: String,
    val campaignId: String,
    val missionId: String,
    val reportDate: String,
    val rating: Int = 5,
    val comment: String = "",
    val preparedImages: List<DraftAttachment> = emptyList(),
    val testStartedAtMs: Long? = null,
    val updatedAt: Long = System.currentTimeMillis(),
)

object MissionReportDraftStore {
    private const val DIRECTORY = "mission_report_drafts"

    private val json = Json {
        ignoreUnknownKeys = true
        encodeDefaults = true
    }

    private fun directory(context: Context): File =
        File(context.noBackupFilesDir, DIRECTORY).apply { mkdirs() }

    private fun draftFile(context: Context, userId: String, campaignId: String, missionId: String, reportDate: String): File {
        val safeName = "${userId}_${campaignId}_${missionId}_${reportDate}.json".replace(Regex("[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]"), "_")
        return File(directory(context), safeName)
    }

    @Synchronized
    fun saveDraft(context: Context, draft: MissionReportDraft) {
        if (draft.userId.isBlank()) return
        val target = draftFile(context, draft.userId, draft.campaignId, draft.missionId, draft.reportDate)
        val temp = File(target.parentFile, "${target.name}.tmp")
        try {
            FileOutputStream(temp).use { stream ->
                stream.write(json.encodeToString(draft).toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8))
                stream.fd.sync()
            }
            Files.move(temp.toPath(), target.toPath(), ATOMIC_MOVE, REPLACE_EXISTING)
        } finally {
            temp.delete()
        }
    }

    @Synchronized
    fun loadDraft(context: Context, userId: String, campaignId: String, missionId: String, reportDate: String): MissionReportDraft? {
        if (userId.isBlank()) return null
        val target = draftFile(context, userId, campaignId, missionId, reportDate)
        if (!target.isFile) return null
        return try {
            json.decodeFromString<MissionReportDraft>(target.readText())
        } catch (_: Exception) {
            null
        }
    }

    @Synchronized
    fun clearDraft(context: Context, userId: String, campaignId: String, missionId: String, reportDate: String) {
        if (userId.isBlank()) return
        val target = draftFile(context, userId, campaignId, missionId, reportDate)
        if (target.isFile) {
            target.delete()
        }
    }

    @Synchronized
    fun clearAll(context: Context) {
        directory(context).deleteRecursively()
        directory(context).mkdirs()
    }
}

data class MissionReportUiState(
    val isLoading: Boolean = true,
    val campaign: Campaign? = null,
    val mission: Mission? = null,
