class MissionReportViewModel(
    private val campaignId: String,
    private val missionId: String,
    private val repository: CampaignRepository,
    private val reportSubmitManager: ReportSubmitManager,
    private val appContext: Context,
    private val savedStateHandle: SavedStateHandle = SavedStateHandle(),
) : ViewModel() {

    private val _uiState = MutableStateFlow(MissionReportUiState())
    val uiState: StateFlow<MissionReportUiState> = _uiState.asStateFlow()

    private var compressionJob: Job? = null
    private var timerJob: Job? = null

    init {
        restoreDraft()
        loadData()
        observeSubmitState()
    }

    private fun draftKey(field: String): String =
        "draft_${campaignId}_${missionId}_$field"

    private fun restoreDraft() {
        val savedComment = savedStateHandle.get<String>(draftKey("comment"))
        val savedRating = savedStateHandle.get<Int>(draftKey("rating"))
        _uiState.update {
            it.copy(
                comment = savedComment ?: it.comment,
                rating = savedRating ?: it.rating,
            )
        }
    }

    private fun persistDurableDraft() {
        val uid = repository.currentUserId() ?: return
        val state = _uiState.value
        val todayDate = VnTime.todayString()
        val draft = MissionReportDraft(
            userId = uid,
            campaignId = campaignId,
            missionId = missionId,
            reportDate = todayDate,
            rating = state.rating,
            comment = state.comment,
            testStartedAtMs = state.testStartedAtMs,
            preparedImages = state.preparedScreenshots.map {
                DraftAttachment(
                    uploadId = it.uploadId,
                    filePath = it.file.absolutePath,
                    thumbnailPath = it.thumbnailFile?.absolutePath,
                    imageHash = it.imageHash,
                    sizeBytes = it.sizeBytes,
                    contentType = it.contentType,
                )
            }
        )
        MissionReportDraftStore.saveDraft(appContext, draft)
    }

    fun loadData() {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            _uiState.update { it.copy(isLoading = true, errorMessage = null) }
            try {
                val camp = repository.getCampaign(campaignId)
                val missionList = repository.getOpenMissions(forceRefresh = true)
                val targetMission = missionList.firstOrNull { it.id == missionId }
                    ?: repository.getCampaignMission(campaignId, missionId)

                val myTodayMissionRep = repository.getMyTodayMissionReport(campaignId, missionId)
                val isJoined = targetMission?.hasJoined == true || myTodayMissionRep != null
                val uid = repository.currentUserId().orEmpty()
                val todayDate = VnTime.todayString()

                val durableDraft = MissionReportDraftStore.loadDraft(appContext, uid, campaignId, missionId, todayDate)
                val restoredComment = when {
                    durableDraft != null && durableDraft.comment.isNotBlank() -> durableDraft.comment
                    _uiState.value.comment.isNotBlank() -> _uiState.value.comment
                    myTodayMissionRep != null -> myTodayMissionRep.content
                    else -> ""
                }
                val restoredRating = durableDraft?.rating ?: myTodayMissionRep?.rating ?: _uiState.value.rating

                // Restore prepared images from durable draft if files exist
                val restoredScreenshots = mutableListOf<PreparedScreenshot>()
                if (durableDraft != null && durableDraft.preparedImages.isNotEmpty()) {
                    for (dAtt in durableDraft.preparedImages) {
                        val file = File(dAtt.filePath)
                        if (file.isFile) {
                            PreparedScreenshotCache.acquireLease(file.absolutePath)
                            val thumbFile = dAtt.thumbnailPath?.let { File(it) }?.takeIf { it.isFile }
                            thumbFile?.let { PreparedScreenshotCache.acquireLease(it.absolutePath) }
                            restoredScreenshots.add(
                                PreparedScreenshot(
                                    uploadId = dAtt.uploadId,
                                    file = file,
                                    imageHash = dAtt.imageHash,
                                    sizeBytes = dAtt.sizeBytes,
                                    contentType = dAtt.contentType,
                                    thumbnailFile = thumbFile,
                                    thumbnailSizeBytes = thumbFile?.length(),
                                )
                            )
                        }
                    }
                }

                _uiState.update {
                    it.copy(
                        isLoading = false,
                        campaign = camp,
                        mission = targetMission,
                        isJoined = isJoined,
                        todayReport = myTodayMissionRep,
                        rating = restoredRating,
                        comment = restoredComment,
                        preparedScreenshots = if (restoredScreenshots.isNotEmpty()) restoredScreenshots else it.preparedScreenshots,
                        testStartedAtMs = durableDraft?.testStartedAtMs ?: it.testStartedAtMs,
                    )
                }
            } catch (e: CancellationException) {
                throw e
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                _uiState.update { it.copy(isLoading = false, errorMessage = e.message) }
            }
        }
    }

    private fun observeSubmitState() {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            reportSubmitManager.stateForMission(campaignId, missionId).collect { state ->
                _uiState.update { it.copy(submitState = state) }
                if (state?.stage == ReportSubmitManager.Stage.DONE) {
                    // Refresh data to show submitted / approved state
                    loadData()
                }
            }
        }
    }

    fun updateRating(newRating: Int) {
        val clamped = newRating.coerceIn(1, 5)
        savedStateHandle[draftKey("rating")] = clamped
        _uiState.update { it.copy(rating = clamped) }
        persistDurableDraft()
    }

    fun updateComment(newComment: String) {
        savedStateHandle[draftKey("comment")] = newComment
        _uiState.update { it.copy(comment = newComment) }
        persistDurableDraft()
    }

    fun joinMission() {
        if (_uiState.value.isJoining) return
        _uiState.update { it.copy(isJoining = true, errorMessage = null) }
        viewModelScope.launch {
            try {
                val res = repository.joinMission(missionId)
                if (res.success) {
                    _uiState.update { it.copy(isJoining = false, isJoined = true, infoMessage = appContext.getString(R.string.mission_join_success)) }
                } else {
                    _uiState.update { it.copy(isJoining = false, errorMessage = "Không thể nhận nhiệm vụ") }
                }
            } catch (e: CancellationException) {
                throw e
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                _uiState.update { it.copy(isJoining = false, errorMessage = e.message) }
            }
        }
    }

    fun recordTestStart() {
        val now = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime()
        _uiState.update { it.copy(testStartedAtMs = now, minTestDurationRemainingSeconds = 10) }
        persistDurableDraft()
        timerJob?.cancel()
        timerJob = viewModelScope.launch {
            for (sec in 10 downTo 0) {
                _uiState.update { it.copy(minTestDurationRemainingSeconds = sec) }
                if (sec > 0) delay(1000L)
            }
        }
    }

    fun addScreenshots(uris: List<Uri>) {
        if (uris.isEmpty()) return
        val current = _uiState.value.preparedScreenshots
        val available = 3 - current.size
        if (available <= 0) {
            _uiState.update { it.copy(errorMessage = appContext.getString(R.string.mission_report_max_photos_reached)) }
            return
        }

        val toProcess = uris.take(available)
        if (uris.size > available) {
            _uiState.update { it.copy(infoMessage = appContext.getString(R.string.mission_report_photos_truncated, available)) }
        }

        compressionJob?.cancel()
        compressionJob = viewModelScope.launch {
            _uiState.update { it.copy(isCompressing = true, compressionError = null) }
            val newPrepared = mutableListOf<PreparedScreenshot>()
            try {
                // Compress sequentially to avoid keeping multiple large bitmaps in memory
                for (uri in toProcess) {
                    val uploadId = PreparedScreenshotCache.newUploadId()
                    val prepared = FirebaseStorageHelper.prepareScreenshot(appContext, uri, uploadId)
                    PreparedScreenshotCache.acquireLease(prepared.file.absolutePath)
                    prepared.thumbnailFile?.let { PreparedScreenshotCache.acquireLease(it.absolutePath) }
                    newPrepared.add(prepared)
                }
                _uiState.update {
                    it.copy(
                        isCompressing = false,
                        preparedScreenshots = it.preparedScreenshots + newPrepared,
                    )
                }
                persistDurableDraft()
            } catch (e: CancellationException) {
                newPrepared.forEach {
                    PreparedScreenshotCache.releaseLease(it.file.absolutePath)
                    it.thumbnailFile?.let { t -> PreparedScreenshotCache.releaseLease(t.absolutePath) }
                }
                throw e
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                newPrepared.forEach {
                    PreparedScreenshotCache.releaseLease(it.file.absolutePath)
                    it.thumbnailFile?.let { t -> PreparedScreenshotCache.releaseLease(t.absolutePath) }
                }
                _uiState.update {
                    it.copy(
                        isCompressing = false,
                        compressionError = e.message ?: appContext.getString(R.string.error_image_read_failed),
                    )
                }
            }
        }
    }

    fun removeScreenshot(index: Int) {
        val current = _uiState.value.preparedScreenshots
        if (index !in current.indices) return
        val removed = current[index]
        PreparedScreenshotCache.releaseLease(removed.file.absolutePath)
        removed.thumbnailFile?.let { PreparedScreenshotCache.releaseLease(it.absolutePath) }

        _uiState.update {
            it.copy(preparedScreenshots = current.filterIndexed { i, _ -> i != index })
        }
        persistDurableDraft()
    }

    fun setPreviewScreenshot(screenshot: PreparedScreenshot?) {
        _uiState.update { it.copy(previewScreenshot = screenshot, previewUrl = null, previewAttachmentId = null) }
    }

    fun setPreviewUrl(url: String?, attachmentId: String? = null) {
        _uiState.update { it.copy(previewUrl = url, previewScreenshot = null, previewAttachmentId = attachmentId) }
    }

    fun clearMessages() {
        _uiState.update { it.copy(errorMessage = null, infoMessage = null) }
    }

    fun submitReport() {
        val state = _uiState.value
        val camp = state.campaign ?: return
        val mission = state.mission ?: return

        if (!state.isJoined) {
            _uiState.update { it.copy(errorMessage = appContext.getString(R.string.mission_not_joined_error)) }
            return
        }

        if (state.isCompressing) {
            _uiState.update { it.copy(errorMessage = appContext.getString(R.string.mission_report_compressing_wait)) }
            return
        }

        val isApproved = state.todayReport?.isApproved == true

        // 10-second actual app open validation (approved comment update is exempt)
        if (!isApproved) {
            if (state.testStartedAtMs == null) {
                _uiState.update { it.copy(errorMessage = "Vui lòng bấm 'Mở app' để kiểm thử ứng dụng trước khi nộp báo cáo") }
                return
            }
            val elapsed = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() - state.testStartedAtMs
            if (elapsed < 10_000L) {
                val remainingSec = ((10_000L - elapsed + 999) / 1000).toInt()
                _uiState.update { it.copy(errorMessage = "Vui lòng trải nghiệm app thêm ${remainingSec}s trước khi gửi") }
                return
            }
        }

        if (!isApproved && state.preparedScreenshots.isEmpty() && state.todayReport?.screenshotUrl == null) {
            _uiState.update { it.copy(errorMessage = appContext.getString(R.string.mission_report_photo_required)) }
            return
        }

        val uid = repository.currentUserId() ?: return
        val clientSubmitId = UUID.randomUUID().toString()

        val request = ReportSubmitManager.SubmitRequest(
            campaignId = campaignId,
            appName = camp.appName,
            userId = uid,
            rating = state.rating,
            comment = state.comment,
            preparedScreenshots = state.preparedScreenshots,
            fallbackScreenshotUrl = state.todayReport?.screenshotUrl,
            fallbackImageHash = state.todayReport?.imageHash,
            needsJoin = false,
            clientSubmitId = clientSubmitId,
            missionId = missionId,
            missionTitle = mission.title,
            submissionContext = "mission",
            expectedDate = VnTime.todayString(),
        )

        viewModelScope.launch {
            val result = reportSubmitManager.submit(request)
            when (result) {
                is ReportSubmitManager.SubmitAdmissionResult.Accepted -> {
                    // Clear local draft upon successful submission admission
                    savedStateHandle.remove<String>(draftKey("comment"))
                    savedStateHandle.remove<Int>(draftKey("rating"))
                    MissionReportDraftStore.clearDraft(appContext, uid, campaignId, missionId, VnTime.todayString())
                }
                is ReportSubmitManager.SubmitAdmissionResult.AlreadyInFlight -> {
                    _uiState.update { it.copy(infoMessage = appContext.getString(R.string.campaign_report_already_in_flight)) }
                }
                is ReportSubmitManager.SubmitAdmissionResult.Blocked -> {
                    _uiState.update { it.copy(errorMessage = result.message ?: result.code) }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    fun retrySubmit() {
        reportSubmitManager.retry(campaignId, missionId)
    }

    override fun onCleared() {
        super.onCleared()
        compressionJob?.cancel()
        timerJob?.cancel()
        _uiState.value.preparedScreenshots.forEach {
            PreparedScreenshotCache.releaseLease(it.file.absolutePath)
            it.thumbnailFile?.let { t -> PreparedScreenshotCache.releaseLease(t.absolutePath) }
        }
    }
}

        context: Context,

        descriptor: ScreenshotDescriptor? = null,

    ): Any? {

        }

        if (crossfade) {
            builder.crossfade(true)
        }

        return builder.build()
    }

**Session Model**: google/antigravity-gemini-3.8-flash (variant medium)  
**Date**: 2026-11-02  
**Target File**: `supabase/migrations/074_app_mission_window_and_multi_attachments.sql`  
**Status**: All 13 groups of root-three-image-probe and all other probes/tests pass individually (100%).

---

## 1. Issue Analysis

- **Defect**: In `_submit_tester_report_core`, `v_submission_context := coalesce(p_submission_context, case when p_mission_id is null then 'app_test' else 'mission' end);` allowed callers of `submit_tester_report_v2` and `submit_tester_report_v3` to supply `p_submission_context => NULL` alongside a valid `p_mission_id`, silently inferring caller intent instead of rejecting it.
- **Contract Requirement**: Deployed migration 064 and the explicit-context contract mandate that `p_submission_context` must be non-null and explicitly either `'app_test'` or `'mission'`, matching the presence/absence of `p_mission_id`. Silent intent inference is forbidden on explicit-context APIs (v2/v3).
- **Legacy Compatibility**: The legacy 8-argument `submit_tester_report` RPC wrapper derives context via `case when p_mission_id is null then 'app_test' else 'mission' end` and passes it explicitly to `_submit_tester_report_core`.

---

## 2. Changes Made in `074_app_mission_window_and_multi_attachments.sql`

1. **`_submit_tester_report_core`**:
   Replaced `coalesce(...)` inference with strict explicit check:
   ```sql
   if p_submission_context is null or p_submission_context not in ('app_test', 'mission')
      or (p_submission_context = 'mission') <> (p_mission_id is not null) then
       raise exception 'INVALID_REPORT_CONTEXT';
   end if;
   v_submission_context := p_submission_context;
   ```

2. **`submit_tester_report_v2`**:
   Added explicit context validation before delegating to core:
   ```sql
   if p_submission_context is null or p_submission_context not in ('app_test', 'mission')
      or (p_submission_context = 'mission') <> (p_mission_id is not null) then
       raise exception 'INVALID_REPORT_CONTEXT';
   end if;
   ```

3. **`submit_tester_report_v3`**:
   Added explicit context validation before delegating to core:
   ```sql
   if p_submission_context is null or p_submission_context not in ('app_test', 'mission')
      or (p_submission_context = 'mission') <> (p_mission_id is not null) then
       raise exception 'INVALID_REPORT_CONTEXT';
   end if;
   ```

4. **Legacy `submit_tester_report` wrapper**:
   Unchanged; passes derived `case when p_mission_id is null then 'app_test' else 'mission' end` to core, ensuring complete backward compatibility without breakage.

---

## 3. Individual Test Results

- `root-three-image-probe.mjs`: **PASS (13/13 groups)**
- `root-daily-coexistence-probe.mjs`: **PASS (2/2 orders)**
- `root-daily-state-matrix.mjs`: **PASS (6 matrix cases + later day)**
- `root-migration-upgrade-probe.mjs`: **PASS (1-day, 2-day historical upgrade + ACL)**
- `npm --prefix supabase/tests run test:mission-window`: **PASS (9/9 integration cases)**
- `node supabase/tests/run-admin-expansion-integration-test.mjs`: **PASS (5/5 admin cases)**
- `node supabase/tests/run-explicit-report-context-test.mjs`: **PASS (8/8 context cases)**

+# Backend Media State: Migration 074
+
+**Session Model**: google/antigravity-gemini-3.8-flash (variant medium)  
+**Date**: 2026-11-02  
+**Target Scope**: `supabase/migrations/074_app_mission_window_and_multi_attachments.sql`  
+**Status**: All 6 groups of `root-media-grant-probe.mjs` and all 25 original root tests (total 31 groups) pass 100%.
+
+---
+
+## 1. Defects Identified & Implemented Fixes
+
+### Defect 1: Primary (null attachment) media grant 5-part HMAC verification failure & overload ambiguity (SQL 42725)
+- **Root Cause**:
+  1. `request_report_media_access` signed 6 colon-separated parts including an empty attachment string when `p_attachment_id` was NULL, whereas `verify_media_access_grant_internal` expects 5 colon-separated parts for legacy/primary grants.
+  2. The 6th argument (`p_attachment_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid`) in `verify_media_access_grant_internal` had a default, which caused PostgreSQL error 42725 (ambiguous function call) when invoked with 5 arguments against the legacy 5-argument overload.
+- **Fix**:
+  1. Updated `request_report_media_access` so that when `p_attachment_id` is NULL, it computes HMAC tokens using the legacy 5-part format `format('%s:%s:%s:%s:%s', p_report_id, v_user_id, v_role, variant, v_expires_epoch)`. When `p_attachment_id` is non-null, it computes HMAC using the 6-part format `format('%s:%s:%s:%s:%s:%s', p_report_id, v_att_part, v_user_id, v_role, variant, v_expires_epoch)`.
+  2. Defined the 6-parameter `verify_media_access_grant_internal` without a default for `p_attachment_id`, and updated the 5-parameter overload to cleanly delegate to the 6-parameter implementation with `null::uuid`. This eliminates overload ambiguity completely.
+
+### Defect 2: Android `MediaAccessGrantResult` DTO field mismatch
+- **Root Cause**: `request_report_media_access` returned `signed_full_url`, `signed_thumbnail_url`, and `expires_epoch`. The Android client's `MediaAccessGrantResult` serializer expects `screenshot_url`, `thumbnail_url`, and `expires_at_epoch`. Without these fields, the client decoded null URLs and fell back to the unsigned gateway path.
+- **Fix**: Added `screenshot_url`, `thumbnail_url`, and `expires_at_epoch` aliases to the returned JSON object while preserving `signed_full_url`, `signed_thumbnail_url`, and `expires_epoch` for backward compatibility.

        val report=TesterReport(id="report",campaignId="campaign",userId="tester",

        val campaign=UUID.randomUUID().toString();val mission=UUID.randomUUID().toString()
        val owner="11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111"
        val userA="22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222";val userB="33333333-3333-3333-3333-333333333333"
        val campJson="""{"id":"$campaign","owner_id":"$owner","app_name":"Draft fixture","package_name":"invalid.draft.app","status":"open"}"""
        val missionJson="""{"id":"$mission","campaign_id":"$campaign","creator_id":"$owner","title":"Draft mission","status":"open","has_joined":true,"ends_at":"${Instant.now().plusSeconds(86400)}"}"""
        val client=createSupabaseClient("https://fixture.invalid","anon-key"){
            install(Auth){sessionManager=MemorySessionManager();codeVerifierCache=MemoryCodeVerifierCache();autoLoadFromStorage=false;autoSaveToStorage=false;enableLifecycleCallbacks=false}
            install(Postgrest)
            httpEngine=MockEngine{request->
                val path=request.url.encodedPath
                val body=when{
                    path.endsWith("/get_campaign_detail")->"""{"campaign":$campJson,"is_member":true,"reports":[]}"""
                    path.endsWith("/campaigns")->"[$campJson]"
                    path.endsWith("/get_open_missions")->"""{"missions":[$missionJson],"server_now":"${Instant.now()}"}"""
                    path.endsWith("/get_campaign_mission")->"""{"mission":$missionJson}"""
                    else->"[]"
                }
                respond(body,HttpStatusCode.OK,headersOf(HttpHeaders.ContentType,"application/json"))
            }
        }
        suspend fun signIn(user:String){
            client.auth.awaitInitialization()
            client.auth.importSession(Json{ignoreUnknownKeys=true}.decodeFromString<UserSession>(
                """{"access_token":"fixture-access","refresh_token":"fixture-refresh","expires_in":3600,"token_type":"bearer","user":{"id":"$user","aud":"authenticated"}}"""))
        }
        fun window(key:String):MissionReportViewModel=MissionReportViewModel(campaign,mission,
            CampaignRepository(client,Localizer(context)),manager,context,SavedStateHandle()).also{store.put(key,it)}
        try{
            signIn(userA)
            val first=window("first");until{!first.uiState.value.isLoading}
            val text="Unsubmitted draft ${UUID.randomUUID()}"
            first.updateComment(text);first.updateRating(3)
            val sources=(0..2).map { index ->
                File(context.cacheDir,"draft-source-${UUID.randomUUID()}.png").also { file ->
                    val bitmap=Bitmap.createBitmap(40,80,Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888)
                    bitmap.eraseColor(android.graphics.Color.rgb(80+index*40,120,170))
                    file.outputStream().use { bitmap.compress(Bitmap.CompressFormat.PNG,100,it) }
                    bitmap.recycle()
                }
            }
            first.addScreenshots(sources.map { Uri.fromFile(it) })
            until{!first.uiState.value.isCompressing}
            assertEquals("fixture must prepare three real local images",3,first.uiState.value.preparedScreenshots.size)
            val prepared=first.uiState.value.preparedScreenshots.toList()
            val beforeBytes=prepared.map { it.file.readBytes() }
            store.clear() // a popped navigation route has a new SavedStateHandle when reopened
            // A process restart loses RAM leases. A still-referenced draft must retain its files.
            PreparedScreenshotCache.clearLeases()
            prepared.forEach { image ->
                image.file.setLastModified(System.currentTimeMillis()-49L*60*60*1000)
                image.thumbnailFile?.setLastModified(System.currentTimeMillis()-49L*60*60*1000)
            }
            PreparedScreenshotCache.cleanup(context)
            val reopened=window("reopened");until{!reopened.uiState.value.isLoading}
            assertEquals("closing a mission window must retain its unsubmitted draft",text,reopened.uiState.value.comment)
            assertEquals(3,reopened.uiState.value.rating)
            assertEquals("draft photos must survive process-start cleanup before the window reopens",3,reopened.uiState.value.preparedScreenshots.size)
            reopened.uiState.value.preparedScreenshots.forEachIndexed { index,image ->
                assertEquals(prepared[index].uploadId,image.uploadId)
                assertEquals(prepared[index].imageHash,image.imageHash)
                assertArrayEquals("retry must reuse the same compressed bytes",beforeBytes[index],image.file.readBytes())
                assertTrue("draft thumbnail must also survive",image.thumbnailFile?.isFile==true)
            }
            reopened.recordTestStart()
            org.robolectric.shadows.ShadowSystemClock.advanceBy(Duration.ofSeconds(11))
            reopened.submitReport()
            val scopeKey=ReportSubmitManager.submitStateKey(userA,campaign,"mission",mission,VnTime.todayString())
            until{manager.currentStateForScope(scopeKey)!=null}
            delay(250);shadowOf(Looper.getMainLooper()).idle()
            assertNotEquals("fixture must not have a successful server receipt yet",ReportSubmitManager.Stage.DONE,manager.currentStateForScope(scopeKey)?.stage)
            store.clear()
            val pendingWindow=window("reopened-during-upload");until{!pendingWindow.uiState.value.isLoading}
            assertEquals("admission without a successful receipt must preserve the draft",text,pendingWindow.uiState.value.comment)
            assertEquals("pending draft must retain photos while upload/retry is unresolved",3,pendingWindow.uiState.value.preparedScreenshots.size)
            store.clear();signIn(userB)
            val other=window("other-account");until{!other.uiState.value.isLoading}
            assertTrue("the other tester must not see the first account's draft",other.uiState.value.comment.isBlank())
            assertTrue("the other tester must not see the first account's photos",other.uiState.value.preparedScreenshots.isEmpty())
        }finally{store.clear();client.close()}
    }

    fun resolveEffectiveUrl(rawUrl: String, descriptor: ScreenshotDescriptor? = null): String {

        ScreenshotManager.clear()

    @Test fun secondThumbnailFallbackKeepsSecondImageAndTrustedExpiry(){
        val second=ReportAttachment("attachment-two",1,"https://fixture.invalid/reports/second.jpg","https://fixture.invalid/reports/thumb_second.jpg")
        val report=TesterReport(id="report",campaignId="campaign",userId="tester",
            screenshotUrl="https://fixture.invalid/reports/first.jpg",thumbnailUrl="https://fixture.invalid/reports/thumb_first.jpg",

        val request=ScreenshotRequestFactory.createRequest(RuntimeEnvironment.getApplication(),second.thumbnailUrl,
            report=report,variant=ScreenshotVariant.THUMBNAIL,attachmentId=second.id) as ImageRequest
        val descriptor=request.tags.tag(ScreenshotDescriptor::class.java)!!
        assertEquals(second.thumbnailUrl,request.data)
        assertEquals(second.screenshotUrl,descriptor.fallbackUrl)
        assertEquals(second.id,descriptor.attachmentId)
        assertEquals(report.createdAt,descriptor.createdAt)
        assertTrue("expired secondary media must fail before network/cache display",ScreenshotManager.isExpired(descriptor))
    }

data class DraftAttachment(

    val imageHash: String,
    val sizeBytes: Long,

    private const val DIRECTORY = "mission_report_drafts"

    private val json = Json {
        ignoreUnknownKeys = true
        encodeDefaults = true
    }

    private fun directory(context: Context): File =
        File(context.noBackupFilesDir, DIRECTORY).apply { mkdirs() }

    private fun draftFile(context: Context, userId: String, campaignId: String, missionId: String, reportDate: String): File {
        val safeName = "${userId}_${campaignId}_${missionId}_${reportDate}.json".replace(Regex("[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]"), "_")
        return File(directory(context), safeName)
    }

    @Synchronized
    fun saveDraft(context: Context, draft: MissionReportDraft) {
        if (draft.userId.isBlank()) return
        val target = draftFile(context, draft.userId, draft.campaignId, draft.missionId, draft.reportDate)
        val temp = File(target.parentFile, "${target.name}.tmp")
        try {
            FileOutputStream(temp).use { stream ->
                stream.write(json.encodeToString(draft).toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8))
                stream.fd.sync()
            }
            Files.move(temp.toPath(), target.toPath(), ATOMIC_MOVE, REPLACE_EXISTING)
        } finally {
            temp.delete()
        }
    }

    @Synchronized
    fun loadDraft(context: Context, userId: String, campaignId: String, missionId: String, reportDate: String): MissionReportDraft? {
        if (userId.isBlank()) return null
        val target = draftFile(context, userId, campaignId, missionId, reportDate)
        if (!target.isFile) return null
        return try {
            json.decodeFromString<MissionReportDraft>(target.readText())
        } catch (_: Exception) {
            null
        }
    }

    @Synchronized
    fun clearDraft(context: Context, userId: String, campaignId: String, missionId: String, reportDate: String) {
        if (userId.isBlank()) return
        val target = draftFile(context, userId, campaignId, missionId, reportDate)
        if (target.isFile) {
            target.delete()
        }
    }

    @Synchronized
    fun clearAll(context: Context) {
        directory(context).deleteRecursively()
        directory(context).mkdirs()
    }

    @Test fun ordinaryDetailDoesNotAdoptAnotherMissionSendingState()=runBlocking{
        Dispatchers.setMain(UnconfinedTestDispatcher())
        val client=createSupabaseClient("https://mock.supabase.co","anon-key"){
            httpEngine=MockEngine {respond("{}",HttpStatusCode.OK,headersOf(HttpHeaders.ContentType,"application/json"))}
            install(Auth){sessionManager=MemorySessionManager();codeVerifierCache=MemoryCodeVerifierCache();enableLifecycleCallbacks=false}
            install(Postgrest)
        }
        val store=ViewModelStore()
        try{
            val vm=CampaignDetailViewModel(campaign,CampaignRepository(client,Localizer(context)),manager,user,Localizer(context),context)
            store.put("ordinary-window",vm)
            val missionRequest=request(true)
            assertTrue(manager.submit(missionRequest) is ReportSubmitManager.SubmitAdmissionResult.Accepted)
            until{manager.currentStateForScope(key(missionRequest))?.stage==ReportSubmitManager.Stage.SENDING}
            shadowOf(Looper.getMainLooper()).idle();delay(700)
            assertNull("ordinary detail must keep its own slot available while a mission uploads",vm.uiState.value.submitStage)
        }finally{store.clear();client.close();Dispatchers.resetMain()}
    }
    @Test fun admissionBlocksBeforeExceedingPendingBudgetWithoutEvictingAcceptedWork()=runBlocking{
        fun largeRequest():ReportSubmitManager.SubmitRequest{
            val req=request(true).copy(campaignId=UUID.randomUUID().toString())
            req.preparedScreenshots.forEach { image -> java.io.RandomAccessFile(image.file,"rw").use { it.setLength(1_900_000) } }
            return req
        }
        val accepted=(1..3).map { largeRequest() }
        accepted.forEach { assertTrue(manager.submit(it) is ReportSubmitManager.SubmitAdmissionResult.Accepted) }
        val excess=largeRequest()
        val outcome=manager.submit(excess)
        assertTrue("a full pending store must explain capacity before accepting more work: $outcome",outcome is ReportSubmitManager.SubmitAdmissionResult.Blocked)
        assertNull("blocked admission must not leave a runnable pending record",PendingReportStore.read(context,excess.clientSubmitId))
        accepted.forEach { assertNotNull("accepted work must never be evicted to admit a new request",PendingReportStore.read(context,it.clientSubmitId)) }
        val actualBytes=PendingReportStore.directory(context).walkTopDown().filter{it.isFile}.sumOf{it.length()}
        assertTrue("queue budget counts each actual physical file once",actualBytes<=20L*1024*1024)
    }

# Backend Media State: Migration 074

**Session Model**: google/antigravity-gemini-3.8-flash (variant medium)  
**Date**: 2026-11-02  
**Target Scope**: `supabase/migrations/074_app_mission_window_and_multi_attachments.sql`  
**Status**: All 6 groups of `root-media-grant-probe.mjs` and all 25 original root tests (total 31 groups) pass 100%.

---

## 1. Defects Identified & Implemented Fixes

### Defect 1: Primary (null attachment) media grant 5-part HMAC verification failure & overload ambiguity (SQL 42725)
- **Root Cause**:
  1. `request_report_media_access` signed 6 colon-separated parts including an empty attachment string when `p_attachment_id` was NULL, whereas `verify_media_access_grant_internal` expects 5 colon-separated parts for legacy/primary grants.
  2. The 6th argument (`p_attachment_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid`) in `verify_media_access_grant_internal` had a default, which caused PostgreSQL error 42725 (ambiguous function call) when invoked with 5 arguments against the legacy 5-argument overload.
- **Fix**:
  1. Updated `request_report_media_access` so that when `p_attachment_id` is NULL, it computes HMAC tokens using the legacy 5-part format `format('%s:%s:%s:%s:%s', p_report_id, v_user_id, v_role, variant, v_expires_epoch)`. When `p_attachment_id` is non-null, it computes HMAC using the 6-part format `format('%s:%s:%s:%s:%s:%s', p_report_id, v_att_part, v_user_id, v_role, variant, v_expires_epoch)`.
  2. Defined the 6-parameter `verify_media_access_grant_internal` without a default for `p_attachment_id`, and updated the 5-parameter overload to cleanly delegate to the 6-parameter implementation with `null::uuid`. This eliminates overload ambiguity completely.

### Defect 2: Android `MediaAccessGrantResult` DTO field mismatch
- **Root Cause**: `request_report_media_access` returned `signed_full_url`, `signed_thumbnail_url`, and `expires_epoch`. The Android client's `MediaAccessGrantResult` serializer expects `screenshot_url`, `thumbnail_url`, and `expires_at_epoch`. Without these fields, the client decoded null URLs and fell back to the unsigned gateway path.
- **Fix**: Added `screenshot_url`, `thumbnail_url`, and `expires_at_epoch` aliases to the returned JSON object while preserving `signed_full_url`, `signed_thumbnail_url`, and `expires_epoch` for backward compatibility.

    @After fun after(){
        ScreenshotCachePolicy.isMediaGatewayEnabled=false
        ScreenshotCachePolicy.mediaGatewayBaseUrl=""
        ScreenshotCachePolicy.mediaAccessGrantProvider=null
        ScreenshotManager.clear()
    }
    @Test fun secondThumbnailFallbackKeepsSecondImageAndTrustedExpiry(){
        val second=ReportAttachment("attachment-two",1,"https://fixture.invalid/reports/second.jpg","https://fixture.invalid/reports/thumb_second.jpg")
        val report=TesterReport(id="report",campaignId="campaign",userId="tester",
            screenshotUrl="https://fixture.invalid/reports/first.jpg",thumbnailUrl="https://fixture.invalid/reports/thumb_first.jpg",
            createdAt=Instant.now().toString(),mediaExpired=true,attachments=listOf(second))
        val request=ScreenshotRequestFactory.createRequest(RuntimeEnvironment.getApplication(),second.thumbnailUrl,
            report=report,variant=ScreenshotVariant.THUMBNAIL,attachmentId=second.id) as ImageRequest
        val descriptor=request.tags.tag(ScreenshotDescriptor::class.java)!!
        assertEquals(second.thumbnailUrl,request.data)
        assertEquals(second.screenshotUrl,descriptor.fallbackUrl)
        assertEquals(second.id,descriptor.attachmentId)
        assertEquals(report.createdAt,descriptor.createdAt)
        assertTrue("expired secondary media must fail before network/cache display",ScreenshotManager.isExpired(descriptor))
    }
    @Test fun gatewayRequestsTheSelectedAttachmentInsteadOfReportPrimary()=runBlocking{
        var requested:String?="not-called"
        ScreenshotCachePolicy.isMediaGatewayEnabled=true
        ScreenshotCachePolicy.mediaGatewayBaseUrl="https://gateway.invalid/media"
        ScreenshotCachePolicy.mediaAccessGrantProvider=object:MediaAccessGrantProvider{
            override suspend fun getMediaAccessGrant(reportId:String)=MediaAccessGrantResult(true,screenshotUrl="https://signed.invalid/primary")
            override suspend fun getMediaAccessGrant(reportId:String,attachmentId:String?):MediaAccessGrantResult{
                requested=attachmentId
                return MediaAccessGrantResult(true,screenshotUrl="https://signed.invalid/$attachmentId")
            }
            override fun getCurrentAuthToken():String?=null
        }
        val descriptor=ScreenshotDescriptor("https://fixture.invalid/reports/second.jpg",reportId="report",attachmentId="attachment-two")
        val actual=ScreenshotManager.resolveEffectiveUrlAsync(descriptor.url,descriptor)
        assertEquals("attachment-two",requested)
        assertEquals("https://signed.invalid/attachment-two",actual)
        ScreenshotCachePolicy.mediaAccessGrantProvider=null
        val fallback=ScreenshotManager.resolveEffectiveUrl(descriptor.url,descriptor)
        assertTrue("gateway fallback must retain exact attachment identity",fallback.contains("attachment_id=attachment-two"))
    }
    @Test fun syntheticLegacyAttachmentDoesNotBecomeARealAttachmentGrant(){
        val report=TesterReport(id="legacy-report",campaignId="campaign",userId="tester",screenshotUrl="https://fixture.invalid/reports/legacy.jpg")

        val descriptor=ScreenshotRequestFactory.createDescriptor(legacy.screenshotUrl,report,attachmentId=legacy.id)!!
        assertEquals(report.id,descriptor.reportId)
        assertNull("legacy report ID is not an attachment-row ID",descriptor.attachmentId)
    }

    @Test fun unsubmittedDraftSurvivesPoppingRouteAndStaysPrivateToItsAccount()=runBlocking{
        val campaign=UUID.randomUUID().toString();val mission=UUID.randomUUID().toString()
        val owner="11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111"
        val userA="22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222";val userB="33333333-3333-3333-3333-333333333333"
        val campJson="""{"id":"$campaign","owner_id":"$owner","app_name":"Draft fixture","package_name":"invalid.draft.app","status":"open"}"""
        val missionJson="""{"id":"$mission","campaign_id":"$campaign","creator_id":"$owner","title":"Draft mission","status":"open","has_joined":true,"ends_at":"${Instant.now().plusSeconds(86400)}"}"""
        val client=createSupabaseClient("https://fixture.invalid","anon-key"){
            install(Auth){sessionManager=MemorySessionManager();codeVerifierCache=MemoryCodeVerifierCache();autoLoadFromStorage=false;autoSaveToStorage=false;enableLifecycleCallbacks=false}
            install(Postgrest)
            httpEngine=MockEngine{request->
                val path=request.url.encodedPath
                val body=when{

                    path.endsWith("/campaigns")->"[$campJson]"
                    path.endsWith("/get_open_missions")->"""{"missions":[$missionJson],"server_now":"${Instant.now()}"}"""
                    path.endsWith("/get_campaign_mission")->"""{"mission":$missionJson}"""
                    else->"[]"
                }
                respond(body,HttpStatusCode.OK,headersOf(HttpHeaders.ContentType,"application/json"))
            }
        }
        suspend fun signIn(user:String){
            client.auth.awaitInitialization()
            client.auth.importSession(Json{ignoreUnknownKeys=true}.decodeFromString<UserSession>(
                """{"access_token":"fixture-access","refresh_token":"fixture-refresh","expires_in":3600,"token_type":"bearer","user":{"id":"$user","aud":"authenticated"}}"""))
        }
        fun window(key:String):MissionReportViewModel=MissionReportViewModel(campaign,mission,
            CampaignRepository(client,Localizer(context)),manager,context,SavedStateHandle()).also{store.put(key,it)}
        try{
            signIn(userA)
            val first=window("first");until{!first.uiState.value.isLoading}
            val text="Unsubmitted draft ${UUID.randomUUID()}"
            first.updateComment(text);first.updateRating(3)
            val sources=(0..2).map { index ->
                File(context.cacheDir,"draft-source-${UUID.randomUUID()}.png").also { file ->
                    val bitmap=Bitmap.createBitmap(40,80,Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888)
                    bitmap.eraseColor(android.graphics.Color.rgb(80+index*40,120,170))
                    file.outputStream().use { bitmap.compress(Bitmap.CompressFormat.PNG,100,it) }
                    bitmap.recycle()
                }
            }
            first.addScreenshots(sources.map { Uri.fromFile(it) })
            until{!first.uiState.value.isCompressing}
            assertEquals("fixture must prepare three real local images",3,first.uiState.value.preparedScreenshots.size)
            val prepared=first.uiState.value.preparedScreenshots.toList()
            val beforeBytes=prepared.map { it.file.readBytes() }
            store.clear() // a popped navigation route has a new SavedStateHandle when reopened
            // A process restart loses RAM leases. A still-referenced draft must retain its files.
            PreparedScreenshotCache.clearLeases()
            prepared.forEach { image ->
                image.file.setLastModified(System.currentTimeMillis()-49L*60*60*1000)
                image.thumbnailFile?.setLastModified(System.currentTimeMillis()-49L*60*60*1000)
            }
            PreparedScreenshotCache.cleanup(context)
            val reopened=window("reopened");until{!reopened.uiState.value.isLoading}
            assertEquals("closing a mission window must retain its unsubmitted draft",text,reopened.uiState.value.comment)
            assertEquals(3,reopened.uiState.value.rating)
            assertEquals("draft photos must survive process-start cleanup before the window reopens",3,reopened.uiState.value.preparedScreenshots.size)
            reopened.uiState.value.preparedScreenshots.forEachIndexed { index,image ->
                assertEquals(prepared[index].uploadId,image.uploadId)
                assertEquals(prepared[index].imageHash,image.imageHash)
                assertArrayEquals("retry must reuse the same compressed bytes",beforeBytes[index],image.file.readBytes())
                assertTrue("draft thumbnail must also survive",image.thumbnailFile?.isFile==true)
            }
            reopened.recordTestStart()
            org.robolectric.shadows.ShadowSystemClock.advanceBy(Duration.ofSeconds(11))
            reopened.submitReport()
            val scopeKey=ReportSubmitManager.submitStateKey(userA,campaign,"mission",mission,VnTime.todayString())
            until{manager.currentStateForScope(scopeKey)!=null}
            delay(250);shadowOf(Looper.getMainLooper()).idle()
            assertNotEquals("fixture must not have a successful server receipt yet",ReportSubmitManager.Stage.DONE,manager.currentStateForScope(scopeKey)?.stage)
            store.clear()
            val pendingWindow=window("reopened-during-upload");until{!pendingWindow.uiState.value.isLoading}
            assertEquals("admission without a successful receipt must preserve the draft",text,pendingWindow.uiState.value.comment)
            assertEquals("pending draft must retain photos while upload/retry is unresolved",3,pendingWindow.uiState.value.preparedScreenshots.size)
            store.clear();signIn(userB)
            val other=window("other-account");until{!other.uiState.value.isLoading}
            assertTrue("the other tester must not see the first account's draft",other.uiState.value.comment.isBlank())
            assertTrue("the other tester must not see the first account's photos",other.uiState.value.preparedScreenshots.isEmpty())
        }finally{store.clear();client.close()}
    }

    fun resolveEffectiveUrl(rawUrl: String, descriptor: ScreenshotDescriptor? = null): String {
        if (!ScreenshotCachePolicy.isMediaGatewayEnabled || ScreenshotCachePolicy.mediaGatewayBaseUrl.isBlank()) {
            return rawUrl
        }
        if (!isReportScreenshotUrl(rawUrl)) {
            return rawUrl
        }
        val reportId = descriptor?.reportId
            ?: extractReportIdFromUrl(rawUrl)
            ?: return rawUrl
        val variant = if (descriptor?.variant == ScreenshotVariant.THUMBNAIL) "thumb" else "full"
        val base = ScreenshotCachePolicy.mediaGatewayBaseUrl.trimEnd('/')
        return "$base?report_id=$reportId&variant=$variant"
    }

    private fun extractReportIdFromUrl(url: String): String? {

        val report=TesterReport(id="report",campaignId="campaign",userId="tester",

            createdAt=Instant.now().toString(),mediaExpired=true,attachments=listOf(second))
        val request=ScreenshotRequestFactory.createRequest(RuntimeEnvironment.getApplication(),second.thumbnailUrl,
            report=report,variant=ScreenshotVariant.THUMBNAIL,attachmentId=second.id) as ImageRequest
        val descriptor=request.tags.tag(ScreenshotDescriptor::class.java)!!
        assertEquals(second.thumbnailUrl,request.data)
        assertEquals(second.screenshotUrl,descriptor.fallbackUrl)
        assertEquals(second.id,descriptor.attachmentId)
        assertEquals(report.createdAt,descriptor.createdAt)
        assertTrue("expired secondary media must fail before network/cache display",ScreenshotManager.isExpired(descriptor))
    }

            override suspend fun getMediaAccessGrant(reportId:String,attachmentId:String?):MediaAccessGrantResult{
                requested=attachmentId
                return MediaAccessGrantResult(true,screenshotUrl="https://signed.invalid/$attachmentId")
            }
            override fun getCurrentAuthToken():String?=null
        }

@Serializable
data class DraftAttachment(

    val thumbnailPath: String? = null,
    val imageHash: String,
    val sizeBytes: Long,
    val contentType: String = "image/jpeg",
)

    private const val DIRECTORY = "mission_report_drafts"

    private val json = Json {
        ignoreUnknownKeys = true
        encodeDefaults = true
    }

    private fun directory(context: Context): File =
        File(context.noBackupFilesDir, DIRECTORY).apply { mkdirs() }

    private fun draftFile(context: Context, userId: String, campaignId: String, missionId: String, reportDate: String): File {
        val safeName = "${userId}_${campaignId}_${missionId}_${reportDate}.json".replace(Regex("[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]"), "_")
        return File(directory(context), safeName)
    }

    @Synchronized
    fun saveDraft(context: Context, draft: MissionReportDraft) {
        if (draft.userId.isBlank()) return
        val target = draftFile(context, draft.userId, draft.campaignId, draft.missionId, draft.reportDate)
        val temp = File(target.parentFile, "${target.name}.tmp")
        try {
            FileOutputStream(temp).use { stream ->
                stream.write(json.encodeToString(draft).toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8))
                stream.fd.sync()
            }
            Files.move(temp.toPath(), target.toPath(), ATOMIC_MOVE, REPLACE_EXISTING)
        } finally {
            temp.delete()
        }
    }

    @Synchronized
    fun loadDraft(context: Context, userId: String, campaignId: String, missionId: String, reportDate: String): MissionReportDraft? {
        if (userId.isBlank()) return null
        val target = draftFile(context, userId, campaignId, missionId, reportDate)
        if (!target.isFile) return null
        return try {
            json.decodeFromString<MissionReportDraft>(target.readText())
        } catch (_: Exception) {
            null
        }
    }

    @Synchronized
    fun clearDraft(context: Context, userId: String, campaignId: String, missionId: String, reportDate: String) {
        if (userId.isBlank()) return
        val target = draftFile(context, userId, campaignId, missionId, reportDate)
        if (target.isFile) {
            target.delete()
        }
    }

    @Synchronized
    fun clearAll(context: Context) {
        directory(context).deleteRecursively()
        directory(context).mkdirs()
    }

    @Test fun ordinaryDetailDoesNotAdoptAnotherMissionSendingState()=runBlocking{
        Dispatchers.setMain(UnconfinedTestDispatcher())
        val client=createSupabaseClient("https://mock.supabase.co","anon-key"){
            httpEngine=MockEngine {respond("{}",HttpStatusCode.OK,headersOf(HttpHeaders.ContentType,"application/json"))}
            install(Auth){sessionManager=MemorySessionManager();codeVerifierCache=MemoryCodeVerifierCache();enableLifecycleCallbacks=false}
            install(Postgrest)
        }
        val store=ViewModelStore()
        try{
            val vm=CampaignDetailViewModel(campaign,CampaignRepository(client,Localizer(context)),manager,user,Localizer(context),context)
            store.put("ordinary-window",vm)
            val missionRequest=request(true)
            assertTrue(manager.submit(missionRequest) is ReportSubmitManager.SubmitAdmissionResult.Accepted)
            until{manager.currentStateForScope(key(missionRequest))?.stage==ReportSubmitManager.Stage.SENDING}
            shadowOf(Looper.getMainLooper()).idle();delay(700)
            assertNull("ordinary detail must keep its own slot available while a mission uploads",vm.uiState.value.submitStage)
        }finally{store.clear();client.close();Dispatchers.resetMain()}
    }
    @Test fun admissionBlocksBeforeExceedingPendingBudgetWithoutEvictingAcceptedWork()=runBlocking{
        fun largeRequest():ReportSubmitManager.SubmitRequest{
            val req=request(true).copy(campaignId=UUID.randomUUID().toString())
            req.preparedScreenshots.forEach { image -> java.io.RandomAccessFile(image.file,"rw").use { it.setLength(1_900_000) } }
            return req
        }
        val accepted=(1..3).map { largeRequest() }
        accepted.forEach { assertTrue(manager.submit(it) is ReportSubmitManager.SubmitAdmissionResult.Accepted) }
        val excess=largeRequest()
        val outcome=manager.submit(excess)
        assertTrue("a full pending store must explain capacity before accepting more work: $outcome",outcome is ReportSubmitManager.SubmitAdmissionResult.Blocked)
        assertNull("blocked admission must not leave a runnable pending record",PendingReportStore.read(context,excess.clientSubmitId))
        accepted.forEach { assertNotNull("accepted work must never be evicted to admit a new request",PendingReportStore.read(context,it.clientSubmitId)) }
        val actualBytes=PendingReportStore.directory(context).walkTopDown().filter{it.isFile}.sumOf{it.length()}
        assertTrue("queue budget counts each actual physical file once",actualBytes<=20L*1024*1024)
    }

+-- 12. Review isolation for missions: approve, reject, and auto-accept do not mutate ordinary checkins
+
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public._impl_approve_tester_report(
+    p_report_id uuid,
+    p_bonus integer DEFAULT 0
+)
+RETURNS jsonb
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path TO 'public'
+AS $function$
+declare
+    v_caller_id uuid := auth.uid();
+    v_caller_role text;
+    v_caller_locked boolean;
+    v_report record;
+    v_camp record;
+    v_extra_reward int := 2;
+    v_tip int := 0;
+    v_total_bonus int;
+    v_new_balance int;
+    v_owner_bonus int := 0;
+    v_owner_balance int;
+    v_is_owner boolean := false;
+    v_today date := (now() at time zone 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')::date;
+begin
+    perform set_config('app.reviewing_report', 'true', true);
+
+    if v_caller_id is null then
+        raise exception 'NOT_AUTHENTICATED';
+    end if;
+
+    select role, coalesce(is_locked, false)
+    into v_caller_role, v_caller_locked
+    from public.profiles
+    where id = v_caller_id;
+
+    if coalesce(v_caller_locked, false) = true then
+        raise exception 'ACCOUNT_LOCKED: Tài khoản của bạn đã bị khóa';
+    end if;
+
+    select * into v_report
+    from public.tester_reports
+    where id = p_report_id
+    for update;
+
+    if v_report.id is null then
+        raise exception 'REPORT_NOT_FOUND';
+    end if;
+
+    if v_report.status <> 'pending' then
+        raise exception 'REPORT_ALREADY_REVIEWED';
+    end if;
+
+    select * into v_camp
+    from public.campaigns
+    where id = v_report.campaign_id;
+
+    if v_camp.owner_id <> v_caller_id
+       and lower(coalesce(v_caller_role, '')) not in ('admin', 'moderator') then
+        raise exception 'PERMISSION_DENIED';
+    end if;
+
+    if v_report.created_at <= (now() - interval '8 hours') then
+        raise exception 'REPORT_EXPIRED';
+    end if;
+
+    v_is_owner := (v_camp.owner_id = v_caller_id);
+
+    insert into public.report_review_events (
+        report_id, campaign_id, tester_id, owner_id, reviewer_id, event_type
+    ) values (
+        v_report.id, v_report.campaign_id, v_report.user_id,
+        v_camp.owner_id, v_caller_id, 'approve'
+    );
+
+    -- Preserve 069 semantics: p_bonus is ignored to prevent arbitrary caller credit minting
+    v_extra_reward := coalesce(v_report.review_tester_bonus, 2);
+    v_tip := public._grant_report_tip(v_report.campaign_id, v_report.user_id);
+    v_total_bonus := coalesce(v_report.bonus_awarded, coalesce(v_report.provisional_granted_credits, 2)) + v_extra_reward + v_tip;
+
+    update public.tester_reports
+    set status = 'approved',
+        bonus_awarded = v_total_bonus,
+        reviewed_at = now()
+    where id = p_report_id;
+
+    if v_extra_reward > 0 then
+        update public.profiles
+        set credits = credits + v_extra_reward,
+            last_active_date = v_today,
+            missed_streak = 0
+        where id = v_report.user_id
+        returning credits into v_new_balance;
+
+        insert into public.credit_logs (user_id, amount, action, note, balance)
+        values (
+            v_report.user_id,
+            v_extra_reward,
+            'test_approved_bonus',
+            format(
+                '%s duyệt kết quả kiểm thử (Thưởng thêm +%s Credit)',
+                case when v_is_owner then 'Chủ app' else 'Admin/Moderator' end,
+                v_extra_reward
+            ),
+            v_new_balance
+        );
+    else
+        select credits into v_new_balance from public.profiles where id = v_report.user_id;
+    end if;
+
+    if v_is_owner then
+        v_owner_bonus := coalesce(v_report.review_owner_bonus, 2);
+        if v_owner_bonus > 0 then
+            update public.profiles
+            set credits = credits + v_owner_bonus
+            where id = v_camp.owner_id
+            returning credits into v_owner_balance;
+
+            insert into public.credit_logs (user_id, amount, action, note, balance)
+            values (
+                v_camp.owner_id,
+                v_owner_bonus,
+                'owner_approval_bonus',
+                format('Duyệt báo cáo kiểm thử (+%s Credit)', v_owner_bonus),
+                v_owner_balance
+            );
+        else
+            select credits into v_owner_balance from public.profiles where id = v_camp.owner_id;
+        end if;
+    else
+        v_owner_bonus := 0;
+        select credits into v_owner_balance from public.profiles where id = v_camp.owner_id;
+    end if;
+
+    perform public._settle_mission_reward(v_report.id);
+
+    -- Only ordinary app_test reports touch checkins table
+    if coalesce(v_report.submission_context, 'app_test') = 'app_test' then
+        update public.checkins
+        set note = 'Đã kiểm thử và được duyệt'
+        where campaign_id = v_report.campaign_id
+          and user_id = v_report.user_id
+          and checkin_date = (v_report.created_at at time zone 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')::date;
+
+        if not found then
+            insert into public.checkins (campaign_id, user_id, checkin_date, note)
+            values (v_report.campaign_id, v_report.user_id, v_today, 'Đã kiểm thử và được duyệt')
+            on conflict (campaign_id, user_id, checkin_date)
+            do update set note = 'Đã kiểm thử và được duyệt';
+        end if;
+    end if;
+
+    perform set_config('app.reviewing_report', 'false', true);
+
+    return jsonb_build_object(
+        'success', true,
+        'report_id', p_report_id,
+        'tester_id', v_report.user_id,
+        'status', 'approved',
+        'credits_awarded', v_extra_reward,
+        'tip_awarded', v_tip,
+        'owner_credits_awarded', v_owner_bonus,
+        'total_earned', v_total_bonus,
+        'tester_balance', v_new_balance,
+        'owner_balance', v_owner_balance,
+        'message', format(
+            'Duyệt kết quả thành công (Thưởng thêm +%s Credit cho tester%s)',
+            v_extra_reward,
+            case when v_owner_bonus > 0 then format(' và +%s Credit cho bạn', v_owner_bonus) else '' end
+        )
+    );
+end;
+$function$;

+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public._impl_approve_tester_report(uuid, integer) FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;

+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public._impl_reject_tester_report(

+
+    v_extracted_code text;
+    v_final_reason_code text;
+

+    v_tester_warned boolean := false;

+    v_tester_weekly_warnings int := 0;
+    v_is_tester_locked boolean := false;
+
+    v_owner_today_rejections int := 0;
+    v_owner_warned boolean := false;
+    v_owner_warning_msg text := null;
+    v_owner_weekly_warnings int := 0;
+    v_is_owner_locked boolean := false;
+
+    v_msg_tester text := 'Hệ thống ghi nhận bạn tham gia kiểm thử chưa nghiêm túc, đề nghị test app nghiêm túc và chụp ảnh màn hình không trùng với ảnh đã chụp hôm trước (nên chụp các tính năng khác của ứng dụng kiểm thử). Nếu trong 1 tuần bạn bị 3 lần cảnh báo như thế này thì tài khoản của bạn sẽ bị tạm khóa';
+    v_msg_owner text := 'Hệ thống ghi nhận bạn xác nhận kết quả của người kiểm thử chưa nghiêm túc, đề nghị đối chiếu kỹ ảnh chụp của người kiểm thử chụp các ngày khác nhau để duyệt cho chính xác. Nếu trong 1 tuần bạn bị 3 lần cảnh báo như thế này thì tài khoản của bạn sẽ bị tạm khóa';
+begin

+    if v_caller_locked = true then
+        raise exception 'ACCOUNT_LOCKED: Tài khoản của bạn đã bị khóa';
+    end if;
+
+    select * into v_report

+    where id = p_report_id
+    for update;
+
+    if v_report.id is null then
+        raise exception 'REPORT_NOT_FOUND';
+    end if;
+
+    if v_report.status <> 'pending' then
+        raise exception 'REPORT_ALREADY_REVIEWED';
+    end if;
+
+    select * into v_camp
+    from public.campaigns
+    where id = v_report.campaign_id;
+
+    if v_camp.owner_id <> v_caller_id
+       and lower(coalesce(v_caller_role, '')) not in ('admin', 'moderator') then
+        raise exception 'PERMISSION_DENIED';
+    end if;
+
+    if v_report.created_at <= (now() - interval '8 hours') then
+        raise exception 'REPORT_EXPIRED';
+    end if;
+
+    if p_reason is not null and p_reason like '[CODE:%]' then
+        v_extracted_code := substring(p_reason from '\[CODE:([A-Za-z0-9_]+)\]');
+    end if;
+    v_final_reason_code := coalesce(p_reason_code, v_extracted_code);
+
+    insert into public.report_review_events (
+        report_id, campaign_id, tester_id, owner_id, reviewer_id, event_type, reason
+    ) values (
+        v_report.id, v_report.campaign_id, v_report.user_id,

+    );

+    select credits into v_tester_credits

+    where id = p_report_id;
+
+    -- Only ordinary app_test reports touch checkins table

+          and checkin_date = v_report_date

+    end if;
+
+    select count(*) into v_tester_today_rejections
+    from public.report_review_events
+    where tester_id = v_report.user_id
+      and event_type = 'reject'
+      and (created_at at time zone 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')::date = v_vn_today;
+
+    if v_tester_today_rejections >= 3 then
+        if not exists (
+            select 1 from public.user_warnings w
+            where w.user_id = v_report.user_id
+              and w.warning_type = 'tester_rejection_streak'
+              and w.warning_date = v_vn_today
+              and (
+                  to_regclass('public.user_warning_revocations') is null
+                  or not exists (

+                      where r.warning_id = w.id
+                  )
+              )
+        ) then
+            insert into public.user_warnings (user_id, warning_type, message, warning_date, metadata)

+                'tester_rejection_streak',

+                jsonb_build_object('warning_type', 'tester_rejection_streak', 'streak_count', v_tester_today_rejections)

+            v_tester_warning_msg := v_msg_tester;

+              and (
+                  to_regclass('public.user_warning_revocations') is null
+                  or not exists (
+                      select 1 from public.user_warning_revocations r
+                      where r.warning_id = w.id
+                  )
+              )
+        ) then
+            insert into public.user_warnings (user_id, warning_type, message, warning_date, metadata)
+            values (
+                v_camp.owner_id,
+                'owner_rejection_streak',
+                v_msg_owner,
+                v_vn_today,
+                jsonb_build_object('warning_type', 'owner_rejection_streak', 'streak_count', v_owner_today_rejections)
+            );
+            v_owner_warned := true;
+            v_owner_warning_msg := v_msg_owner;
+
+            select count(*) into v_owner_weekly_warnings
+            from public.user_warnings w
+            where w.user_id = v_camp.owner_id
+              and w.warning_date >= (v_vn_today - 6)
+              and (
+                  to_regclass('public.user_warning_revocations') is null
+                  or not exists (
+                      select 1 from public.user_warning_revocations r
+                      where r.warning_id = w.id
+                  )
+              );
+
+            if v_owner_weekly_warnings >= 3 then
+                update public.profiles
+                set is_locked = true
+                where id = v_camp.owner_id;
+                v_is_owner_locked := true;
+            end if;
+        end if;
+    end if;
+
+    perform set_config('app.reviewing_report', 'false', true);
+
+    return jsonb_build_object(
+        'success', true,
+        'report_id', v_report.id,
+        'campaign_id', v_camp.id,
+        'tester_id', v_report.user_id,
+        'status', 'rejected',
+        'credits_deducted', v_deduct,
+        'clawed_credits', v_deduct,
+        'tester_balance', v_new_balance,
+        'new_balance', v_new_balance,
+        'reason_code', v_final_reason_code,
+        'tester_today_rejections', v_tester_today_rejections,
+        'tester_warned', v_tester_warned,
+        'tester_warning_msg', v_tester_warning_msg,
+        'is_tester_locked', v_is_tester_locked,
+        'tester_locked', v_is_tester_locked,
+        'owner_today_rejections', v_owner_today_rejections,
+        'owner_warned', v_owner_warned,
+        'owner_warning_msg', v_owner_warning_msg,
+        'is_owner_locked', v_is_owner_locked,
+        'owner_locked', v_is_owner_locked
+    );
+end;
+$function$;
+
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public._impl_reject_tester_report(uuid, text, text) FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public._impl_reject_tester_report(uuid, text, text) TO service_role;
+
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.auto_accept_expired_reports()
+ RETURNS integer
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO 'public'
+AS $function$
+declare
+    v_report record;
+    v_count int := 0;
+    v_retried int := 0;
+    v_owner_id uuid;
+    v_camp_name text;
+    v_tip int;
+    v_base int;
+    v_total_bonus int;
+begin
+    perform set_config('app.suppress_report_notify', '1', true);
+    perform set_config('app.reviewing_report', 'true', true);
+
+    for v_report in
+        select id, campaign_id, user_id, created_at, bonus_awarded, provisional_granted_credits, submission_context
+        from public.tester_reports
+        where status = 'pending'
+          and created_at <= (now() - interval '8 hours')
+        for update skip locked
+    loop
+        select owner_id, app_name into v_owner_id, v_camp_name
+        from public.campaigns
+        where id = v_report.campaign_id;
+
+        v_tip := public._grant_report_tip(v_report.campaign_id, v_report.user_id);
+        -- Genuine provisional 0 does not fall back to unrelated bonus
+        v_base := coalesce(
+            v_report.provisional_granted_credits,
+            coalesce(nullif(v_report.bonus_awarded, 0), case when coalesce(v_report.submission_context, 'app_test') = 'app_test' then 2 else 0 end)
+        );
+        -- Retain provisional reward only + tip; no extra manual review bonus in auto approval
+        v_total_bonus := v_base + v_tip;
+
+        update public.tester_reports
+        set status = 'approved',
+            bonus_awarded = v_total_bonus,
+            reviewed_at = now()
+        where id = v_report.id;
+
+        insert into public.report_review_events (
+            report_id, campaign_id, tester_id, owner_id, reviewer_id, event_type
+        ) values (
+            v_report.id, v_report.campaign_id, v_report.user_id,
+            v_owner_id, null, 'auto_accept'
+        );
+
+        -- Only ordinary app_test reports touch checkins table
+        if coalesce(v_report.submission_context, 'app_test') = 'app_test' then
+            update public.checkins
+            set note = 'Tự động duyệt sau 8h'
+            where campaign_id = v_report.campaign_id
+              and user_id = v_report.user_id
+              and checkin_date = (v_report.created_at at time zone 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')::date;
+
+            if not found then
+                insert into public.checkins (campaign_id, user_id, checkin_date, note)
+                values (
+                    v_report.campaign_id, v_report.user_id,
+                    (v_report.created_at at time zone 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')::date,
+                    'Tự động duyệt sau 8h'
+                )
+                on conflict (campaign_id, user_id, checkin_date)
+                do update set note = 'Tự động duyệt sau 8h';
+            end if;
+        end if;
+
+        -- M03: Gọi settlement với report_id
+        perform public._settle_mission_reward(v_report.id);
+
+        insert into public.notifications (user_id, title, message, type, data)
+        values (
+            v_report.user_id,
+            'Báo cáo kiểm thử tự động duyệt ⏱️',
+            case
+                when v_tip > 0 then
+                    format('Báo cáo của bạn cho ứng dụng "%s" đã được hệ thống tự động duyệt sau 8 giờ (giữ nguyên %s Credit của lượt test này + %s Credit boa từ chủ app). Cảm ơn bạn!', coalesce(v_camp_name, 'ứng dụng'), v_base, v_tip)
+                else
+                    format('Báo cáo của bạn cho ứng dụng "%s" đã được hệ thống tự động duyệt sau 8 giờ (giữ nguyên %s Credit của lượt test này). Cảm ơn bạn!', coalesce(v_camp_name, 'ứng dụng'), v_base)
+            end,
+            'report',
+            jsonb_build_object(
+                'report_id', v_report.id,
+                'campaign_id', v_report.campaign_id,
+                'status', 'approved',
+                'auto_accepted', true
+            )
+        );
+
+        v_count := v_count + 1;
+    end loop;
+
+    -- M05: Tự động chạy retry các settlement job thất bại trong lượt quét định kỳ
+    v_retried := public.retry_failed_mission_settlements(50);
+
+    -- R06: Reset cờ suppress notification trước khi trả về
+    perform set_config('app.suppress_report_notify', '0', true);
+
+    return v_count;
+end;
+$function$;
+
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.auto_accept_expired_reports() FROM PUBLIC, anon;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.auto_accept_expired_reports() TO authenticated, service_role;
